import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";

const ThemeContext = createContext(null);

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-theme") || "dark";
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);

    localStorage.setItem("evidence-vault-theme", theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setTheme((currentTheme) => (currentTheme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"));
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider
      value={{
        theme,
        toggleTheme,
        isDark: theme === "dark",
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider");
  }

  return context;
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  ShieldCheck,
  Clock,
  User,
  FileText,
  AlertCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

import { getDocuments } from "../services/documentService";
import { getDocumentAuditHistory } from "../services/auditService";

import "../styles/audit.css";

function Audit() {
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState([]);
  const [selectedDocumentId, setSelectedDocumentId] = useState("");
  const [auditLogs, setAuditLogs] = useState([]);

  const [loadingDocuments, setLoadingDocuments] = useState(true);
  const [loadingAudit, setLoadingAudit] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");

  const loadDocuments = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingDocuments(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await getDocuments({
        page: 0,
        size: 100,
      });

      const records = response?.content || [];
      setDocuments(records);

      if (records.length > 0) {
        setSelectedDocumentId(
          (currentId) => currentId || String(records[0].id),
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Unable to load documents.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingDocuments(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadAuditHistory = useCallback(async (documentId) => {
    if (!documentId) {
      setAuditLogs([]);
      return;
    }

    setLoadingAudit(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await getDocumentAuditHistory(documentId);
      setAuditLogs(Array.isArray(response) ? response : []);
    } catch (err) {
      setAuditLogs([]);
      setError(err.message || "Unable to load audit history.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingAudit(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDocuments();
  }, [loadDocuments]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDocumentId) {
      loadAuditHistory(selectedDocumentId);
    }
  }, [selectedDocumentId, loadAuditHistory]);

  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    const term = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return auditLogs;

    return auditLogs.filter((log) =>
      [log.username, log.action, log.details, log.documentId]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term),
    );
  }, [auditLogs, searchTerm]);

  const selectedDocument = documents.find(
    (document) => String(document.id) === selectedDocumentId,
  );

  const formatDate = (value) => {
    if (!value) return "Unknown date";

    const date = new Date(value);

    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value;

    return date.toLocaleString();
  };

  const formatAction = (action) =>
    String(action || "UNKNOWN").replaceAll("_", " ");

  const getActionClass = (action) => {
    const value = String(action || "").toUpperCase();

    if (value.includes("DELETE")) return "audit-action-delete";
    if (value.includes("RESTORE")) return "audit-action-restore";
    if (value.includes("UPLOAD")) return "audit-action-upload";
    if (value.includes("DOWNLOAD")) return "audit-action-download";
    if (value.includes("PREVIEW")) return "audit-action-preview";

    return "audit-action-default";
  };

  return (
    <main className="audit-page">
      <section className="audit-header">
        <div>
          <div className="audit-title-row">
            <ShieldCheck size={28} />
            <h1>Audit Trail</h1>
          </div>

          <p>Track document activities, users, and recorded events.</p>
        </div>

        <button
          className="audit-refresh-button"
          onClick={() => {
            if (selectedDocumentId) {
              loadAuditHistory(selectedDocumentId);
            } else {
              loadDocuments();
            }
          }}
          disabled={loadingAudit || loadingDocuments}
        >
          <RefreshCw size={16} />
          Refresh
        </button>
      </section>

      <section className="audit-controls">
        <div className="audit-document-selector">
          <label htmlFor="audit-document">Select Document</label>

          <select
            id="audit-document"
            value={selectedDocumentId}
            onChange={(event) => setSelectedDocumentId(event.target.value)}
            disabled={loadingDocuments || documents.length === 0}
          >
            {documents.length === 0 && (
              <option value="">No documents available</option>
            )}

            {documents.map((document) => (
              <option key={document.id} value={String(document.id)}>
                #{document.id} — {document.originalFilename}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="audit-search">
          <Search size={17} />

          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search user, action or details..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(event) => setSearchTerm(event.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      </section>

      {selectedDocument && (
        <section className="audit-document-card">
          <div className="audit-document-icon">
            <FileText size={22} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <h3>{selectedDocument.originalFilename}</h3>
            <p>
              Document ID: #{selectedDocument.id}
              {" · "}
              Category: {selectedDocument.category}
              {" · "}
              Status: {selectedDocument.status}
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="audit-error">
          <AlertCircle size={18} />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <section className="audit-summary">
        <div className="audit-summary-icon">
          <Activity size={21} />
        </div>

        <div>
          <span>Total Recorded Events</span>
          <strong>{auditLogs.length}</strong>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="audit-history-section">
        <div className="audit-section-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>Activity History</h2>
            <p>Events are displayed in newest-first order.</p>
          </div>

          <span className="audit-event-count">
            {filteredLogs.length} events
          </span>
        </div>

        {loadingDocuments || loadingAudit ? (
          <div className="audit-state">
            <RefreshCw className="audit-spin" size={24} />
            <p>Loading audit history...</p>
          </div>
        ) : filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="audit-state">
            <FileText size={32} />
            <h3>No audit events found</h3>
            <p>
              {auditLogs.length === 0
                ? "No recorded activities are available for this document."
                : "Try a different search term."}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="audit-table-wrapper">
            <table className="audit-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Event ID</th>
                  <th>Action</th>
                  <th>User</th>
                  <th>Details</th>
                  <th>Timestamp</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody>
                {filteredLogs.map((log) => (
                  <tr key={log.id}>
                    <td>#{log.id}</td>

                    <td>
                      <span
                        className={`audit-action ${getActionClass(log.action)}`}
                      >
                        {formatAction(log.action)}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td>
                      <span className="audit-user">
                        <User size={15} />
                        {log.username}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td>{log.details || "—"}</td>

                    <td>
                      <span className="audit-time">
                        <Clock size={14} />
                        {formatDate(log.createdAt)}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

export default Audit;

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

  ArrowRight,
  ArrowUpRight,

  Clock3,
  Cloud,
  Database,
  FileCheck2,

  ShieldCheck,
  Trash2,

} from "lucide-react";

import {
  Area,
  AreaChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  Cell,
  Legend,
  Pie,
  PieChart,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from "recharts";

import { useAuth } from "../context/AuthContext";
import { USER_ROLES } from "../config/constants";

import { getDashboardData } from "../services/dashboardService";

import "../styles/dashboard.css";

const CHART_COLORS = ["#22c55e", "#ef4444", "#f59e0b"];

function toArray(data) {
  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;

  if (Array.isArray(data?.content)) return data.content;
  if (Array.isArray(data?.items)) return data.items;
  if (Array.isArray(data?.results)) return data.results;

  return [];
}

function formatNumber(value) {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return "—";

  return Number(value).toLocaleString();
}

function formatBytes(bytes) {
  const value = Number(bytes);

  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return "—";
  if (value === 0) return "0 Bytes";

  const units = ["Bytes", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const index = Math.min(
    Math.floor(Math.log(value) / Math.log(1024)),
    units.length - 1,
  );

  return `${(value / Math.pow(1024, index)).toFixed(1)} ${units[index]}`;
}

function formatSeconds(value) {
  if (
    value === null ||
    value === undefined ||
    value === "" ||
    !Number.isFinite(Number(value))
  ) {
    return "—";
  }

  return `${Number(value).toFixed(3)} sec`;
}

function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return "Not recorded";

  const date = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "Not recorded";

  return date.toLocaleString(undefined, {
    dateStyle: "medium",
    timeStyle: "short",
  });
}

function getLatestRecord(records) {
  if (!records.length) return null;

  return [...records].sort((a, b) => {
    return new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at);
  })[0];
}

function normalizeStatus(value) {
  return String(value || "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase();
}

function getStatusTone(value) {
  const status = normalizeStatus(value);

  if (["UP", "SUCCESS", "COMPLETED", "VERIFIED", "ACTIVE"].includes(status)) {
    return "success";
  }

  if (["FAILED", "DOWN", "ERROR", "CORRUPTED", "MISMATCH"].includes(status)) {
    return "danger";
  }

  if (
    ["PENDING", "WARNING", "RECOVERY_REQUIRED", "IN_PROGRESS"].includes(status)
  ) {
    return "warning";
  }

  return "neutral";
}

function StatusPill({ status, label }) {
  const tone = getStatusTone(status);

  return (
    <span className={`dash-status dash-status-${tone}`}>
      <span className="dash-status-dot" />
      {label || normalizeStatus(status).replaceAll("_", " ")}
    </span>
  );
}

function SectionHeading({ eyebrow, title, description, action }) {
  return (
    <div className="dash-section-heading">
      <div>
        {eyebrow && <span className="dash-eyebrow">{eyebrow}</span>}
        <h2>{title}</h2>
        {description && <p>{description}</p>}
      </div>

      {action}
    </div>
  );
}

function MetricCard({
  title,
  value,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  tone = "blue",
  to,
}) {
  const content = (
    <>
      <div className={`dash-metric-icon tone-${tone}`}>
        <Icon size={20} />
      </div>

      <div className="dash-metric-content">
        <span className="dash-metric-title">{title}</span>
        <strong>{value}</strong>
        <small>{description}</small>
      </div>

      {to && <ArrowUpRight className="dash-metric-arrow" size={17} />}
    </>
  );

  if (to) {
    return (
      <Link to={to} className="dash-metric-card">
        {content}
      </Link>
    );
  }

  return <article className="dash-metric-card">{content}</article>;
}

function EmptyState({ icon: Icon = Files, title, description }) {
  return (
    <div className="dash-empty">
      <Icon size={27} />
      <strong>{title}</strong>
      <span>{description}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function RegionCard({
  region,
  code,
  name,
  verification,
  verifiedAt,
  secondary = false,
}) {
  const hasResult = verification === true || verification === false;

  return (
    <article className="dash-region-card">
      <div className="dash-region-top">
        <div className={`dash-region-flag ${secondary ? "singapore" : ""}`}>
          {region}
        </div>

        <div className="dash-region-info">
          <strong>{name}</strong>
          <span>{code}</span>
        </div>

        <span className="dash-region-type">
          {secondary ? "REPLICA" : "PRIMARY"}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="dash-region-bottom">
        <div>
          <span>Last recorded verification</span>
          <strong>
            {hasResult
              ? verification
                ? "Checksum verified"
                : "Verification failed"
              : "No verification recorded"}
          </strong>
        </div>

        <StatusPill
          status={
            hasResult ? (verification ? "VERIFIED" : "FAILED") : "UNKNOWN"
          }
          label={
            hasResult ? (verification ? "Verified" : "Failed") : "Not checked"
          }
        />
      </div>

      <small className="dash-region-date">
        {verifiedAt ? formatDate(verifiedAt) : "Awaiting first recorded drill"}
      </small>
    </article>
  );
}

function Dashboard() {
  const { hasRole, user } = useAuth();

  const canViewRecovery = hasRole([USER_ROLES.ADMIN, USER_ROLES.AUDITOR]);

  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [pageError, setPageError] = useState("");
  const [lastUpdated, setLastUpdated] = useState(null);

  const loadDashboard = useCallback(
    async (isRefresh = false) => {
      if (isRefresh) {
        setRefreshing(true);
      } else {
        setLoading(true);
      }

      setPageError("");

      try {
        const result = await getDashboardData({
          includeRecoveryData: canViewRecovery,
        });

        setDashboard(result);
        setLastUpdated(new Date());
      } catch (error) {
        setPageError(error?.message || "Unable to load dashboard information.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [canViewRecovery],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboard();
  }, [loadDashboard]);

  const documents = dashboard?.documents || {
    total: 0,
    active: 0,
    deleted: 0,
    corrupted: 0,
    recent: [],
  };

  const metrics = useMemo(() => toArray(dashboard?.metrics), [dashboard]);

  const drills = useMemo(() => toArray(dashboard?.drills), [dashboard]);

  const manifests = useMemo(() => toArray(dashboard?.manifests), [dashboard]);

  const recentDocuments = useMemo(() => {
    return [...toArray(documents.recent)].sort(
      (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt),
    );
  }, [documents.recent]);

  const latestDrill = useMemo(() => getLatestRecord(drills), [drills]);

  const latestManifest = useMemo(() => getLatestRecord(manifests), [manifests]);

  const drillSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const successful = drills.filter((item) =>
      ["SUCCESS", "COMPLETED"].includes(normalizeStatus(item.drill_status)),
    ).length;

    const failed = drills.filter(
      (item) => normalizeStatus(item.drill_status) === "FAILED",
    ).length;

    const attention = drills.filter((item) =>
      ["RECOVERY_REQUIRED", "WARNING"].includes(
        normalizeStatus(item.drill_status),
      ),
    ).length;

    return {
      total: drills.length,
      successful,
      failed,
      attention,
      successRate: drills.length
        ? Number(((successful / drills.length) * 100).toFixed(1))
        : null,
      recoveryOperations: drills.filter(
        (item) => item.recovery_performed === true,
      ).length,
    };
  }, [drills]);

  const metricSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const rtoValues = metrics
      .map((item) => Number(item.recovery_workflow_seconds))
      .filter(Number.isFinite);

    const rpoValues = metrics
      .map((item) => Number(item.estimated_rpo_seconds))
      .filter(Number.isFinite);

    const average = (values) =>
      values.length
        ? values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length
        : null;

    return {
      averageRto: average(rtoValues),
      averageRpo: average(rpoValues),
      replicationCompleted: metrics.filter(
        (item) => item.replication_status === "COMPLETED",
      ).length,
      replicationFailed: metrics.filter(
        (item) => item.replication_status === "FAILED",
      ).length,
      replicationObserved: metrics.filter(
        (item) => item.replication_status !== "NOT_AVAILABLE",
      ).length,
    };
  }, [metrics]);

  const rtoChartData = useMemo(() => {
    return [...metrics]
      .filter((item) => Number.isFinite(Number(item.recovery_workflow_seconds)))
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at))
      .slice(-10)
      .map((item, index) => ({
        name: `Drill ${index + 1}`,
        rto: Number(item.recovery_workflow_seconds),
        date: formatDate(item.created_at),
      }));
  }, [metrics]);

  const drillChartData = useMemo(() => {
    return [
      { name: "Successful", value: drillSummary.successful },
      { name: "Failed", value: drillSummary.failed },
      { name: "Attention", value: drillSummary.attention },
    ].filter((item) => item.value > 0);
  }, [drillSummary]);

  const system = dashboard?.system;

  const systemHealthy =
    system?.application === "UP" && system?.database === "UP";

  const latestDrillDate = latestDrill?.created_at;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <main className="dashboard-page">
        <div className="dash-loading">
          <RefreshCw className="spin" size={25} />
          <strong>Preparing your EvidenceVault overview</strong>
          <span>
            Collecting document, infrastructure and recovery information.
          </span>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (pageError && !dashboard) {
    return (
      <main className="dashboard-page">
        <div className="dash-error">
          <AlertTriangle size={30} />
          <h2>Dashboard unavailable</h2>
          <p>{pageError}</p>
          <button onClick={() => loadDashboard()}>
            <RefreshCw size={16} />
            Try again
          </button>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  return (
    <main className="dashboard-page">
      {/* PAGE HEADER */}
      <header className="dash-page-header">
        <div>
          <span className="dash-eyebrow">EVIDENCE VAULT / OVERVIEW</span>
          <h1>Good to see you, {user?.username || "User"}</h1>
          <p>
            Your document protection, infrastructure and recovery operations at
            a glance.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="dash-header-actions">
          <div className="dash-updated">
            <span>Last updated</span>
            <strong>
              {lastUpdated
                ? lastUpdated.toLocaleTimeString([], {
                    hour: "2-digit",
                    minute: "2-digit",
                  })
                : "—"}
            </strong>
          </div>

          <button
            className="dash-refresh-button"
            onClick={() => loadDashboard(true)}
            disabled={refreshing}
          >
            <RefreshCw size={16} className={refreshing ? "spin" : ""} />
            {refreshing ? "Refreshing" : "Refresh"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {pageError && (
        <div className="dash-alert dash-alert-warning">
          <AlertTriangle size={17} />
          Some information could not be refreshed. Check the affected sections
          below.
        </div>
      )}

      {/* SYSTEM STATUS STRIP */}
      <section className="dash-system-banner">
        <div className="dash-system-banner-main">
          <span
            className={`dash-system-pulse ${systemHealthy ? "healthy" : "unhealthy"}`}
          />
          <div>
            <strong>
              {systemHealthy
                ? "Core application services are responding"
                : "Core service status needs attention"}
            </strong>
            <span>
              Application and database connectivity reported by the backend
              status endpoint.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="dash-system-banner-status">
          <StatusPill
            status={system?.application || "UNKNOWN"}
            label={`Application ${system?.application || "Unknown"}`}
          />
          <StatusPill
            status={system?.database || "UNKNOWN"}
            label={`Database ${system?.database || "Unknown"}`}
          />
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* DOCUMENT KPI CARDS */}
      <section className="dash-section">
        <SectionHeading
          eyebrow="DOCUMENT LIFECYCLE"
          title="Document overview"
          description="Understand how many documents are stored and their current lifecycle state."
          action={
            <Link to="/documents" className="dash-text-link">
              Manage documents <ArrowRight size={15} />
            </Link>
          }
        />

        <div className="dash-metric-grid">
          <MetricCard
            title="Total documents"
            value={formatNumber(documents.total)}
            description="All document records"
            icon={Files}
            tone="blue"
            to="/documents"
          />

          <MetricCard
            title="Active documents"
            value={formatNumber(documents.active)}
            description="Available in the vault"
            icon={FileCheck2}
            tone="green"
            to="/documents"
          />

          <MetricCard
            title="Recently deleted"
            value={formatNumber(documents.deleted)}
            description="Soft-deleted records"
            icon={Trash2}
            tone="orange"
            to="/documents"
          />

          <MetricCard
            title="Corrupted documents"
            value={formatNumber(documents.corrupted)}
            description="Integrity attention required"
            icon={ShieldAlert}
            tone="red"
            to="/documents"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="dash-document-summary">
          <div className="dash-summary-label">
            <span>Active document ratio</span>
            <strong>
              {documents.total
                ? `${((documents.active / documents.total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`
                : "—"}
            </strong>
          </div>

          <div className="dash-progress-track">
            <div
              className="dash-progress-active"
              style={{
                width: documents.total
                  ? `${Math.min((documents.active / documents.total) * 100, 100)}%`
                  : "0%",
              }}
            />
          </div>

          <span>
            {formatNumber(documents.active)} active out of{" "}
            {formatNumber(documents.total)} total records
          </span>
        </div>

        {dashboard?.errors?.documents && (
          <p className="dash-section-error">
            Document information could not be loaded:{" "}
            {dashboard.errors.documents}
          </p>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* RECOVERY KPI CARDS */}
      <section className="dash-section">
        <SectionHeading
          eyebrow="BUSINESS CONTINUITY"
          title="Disaster recovery performance"
          description="Measured results from previously recorded recovery operations."
          action={
            canViewRecovery ? (
              <Link to="/recovery" className="dash-text-link">
                Open recovery center <ArrowRight size={15} />
              </Link>
            ) : null
          }
        />

        {canViewRecovery ? (
          <>
            <div className="dash-metric-grid dash-recovery-grid">
              <MetricCard
                title="Total DR drills"
                value={formatNumber(drillSummary.total)}
                description="Recorded operations"
                icon={Activity}
                tone="blue"
              />

              <MetricCard
                title="Drill success rate"
                value={
                  drillSummary.successRate === null
                    ? "—"
                    : `${drillSummary.successRate}%`
                }
                description={`${drillSummary.successful} successful`}
                icon={CheckCircle2}
                tone="green"
              />

              <MetricCard
                title="Average recovery time"
                value={formatSeconds(metricSummary.averageRto)}
                description="Measured recovery workflow"
                icon={Clock3}
                tone="purple"
              />

              <MetricCard
                title="Estimated RPO"
                value={formatSeconds(metricSummary.averageRpo)}
                description="Average timestamp-based estimate"
                icon={ArrowDownToLine}
                tone="orange"
              />

              <MetricCard
                title="Recovery operations"
                value={formatNumber(drillSummary.recoveryOperations)}
                description="Drills where recovery was performed"
                icon={RefreshCw}
                tone="blue"
              />

              <MetricCard
                title="Recovery manifests"
                value={formatNumber(manifests.length)}
                description="Recorded recovery evidence"
                icon={FileCheck2}
                tone="green"
              />
            </div>

            {dashboard?.errors?.metrics && (
              <p className="dash-section-error">
                Recovery metrics unavailable: {dashboard.errors.metrics}
              </p>
            )}

            {dashboard?.errors?.drills && (
              <p className="dash-section-error">
                Drill history unavailable: {dashboard.errors.drills}
              </p>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="dash-permission-note">
            <ShieldCheck size={21} />
            <div>
              <strong>Recovery analytics are role-restricted</strong>
              <span>
                Detailed drill history, RTO and recovery evidence are available
                to Admin and Auditor accounts.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* ANALYTICS AND SYSTEM HEALTH */}
      <section className="dash-content-grid">
        <div className="dash-panel">
          <SectionHeading
            eyebrow="PERFORMANCE"
            title="Recovery time trend"
            description="Recovery workflow duration from recorded metrics."
          />

          {canViewRecovery && rtoChartData.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="dash-chart">
              <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={260}>
                <AreaChart data={rtoChartData}>
                  <defs>
                    <linearGradient id="rtoFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                      <stop
                        offset="0%"
                        stopColor="#6385f5"
                        stopOpacity={0.35}
                      />
                      <stop
                        offset="95%"
                        stopColor="#6385f5"
                        stopOpacity={0.02}
                      />
                    </linearGradient>
                  </defs>

                  <CartesianGrid
                    stroke="var(--border-color)"
                    strokeDasharray="4 4"
                    vertical={false}
                  />

                  <XAxis
                    dataKey="name"
                    tick={{ fill: "var(--text-muted)", fontSize: 11 }}
                    axisLine={false}
                    tickLine={false}
                  />

                  <YAxis
                    tick={{ fill: "var(--text-muted)", fontSize: 11 }}
                    axisLine={false}
                    tickLine={false}
                    width={42}
                  />

                  <Tooltip
                    contentStyle={{
                      background: "var(--bg-card)",
                      border: "1px solid var(--border-color)",
                      borderRadius: 10,
                      color: "var(--text-primary)",
                    }}
                    formatter={(value) => [
                      `${Number(value).toFixed(3)} sec`,
                      "Recovery time",
                    ]}
                    labelFormatter={(label, payload) =>
                      payload?.[0]?.payload?.date || label
                    }
                  />

                  <Area
                    type="monotone"
                    dataKey="rto"
                    stroke="#6385f5"
                    strokeWidth={2.5}
                    fill="url(#rtoFill)"
                    activeDot={{ r: 5 }}
                  />
                </AreaChart>
              </ResponsiveContainer>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Clock3}
              title="No recovery measurements yet"
              description={
                canViewRecovery
                  ? "Run a recovery drill to start building your RTO history."
                  : "Recovery measurements are restricted to Admin and Auditor roles."
              }
            />
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="dash-panel">
          <SectionHeading
            eyebrow="OUTCOMES"
            title="Drill results"
            description="Distribution of recorded recovery drill outcomes."
          />

          {canViewRecovery && drillChartData.length > 0 ? (
            <>
              <div className="dash-chart dash-pie-chart">
                <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={220}>
                  <PieChart>
                    <Pie
                      data={drillChartData}
                      dataKey="value"
                      nameKey="name"
                      innerRadius={57}
                      outerRadius={83}
                      paddingAngle={4}
                    >
                      {drillChartData.map((entry, index) => (
                        <Cell
                          key={entry.name}
                          fill={CHART_COLORS[index % CHART_COLORS.length]}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </Pie>

                    <Tooltip
                      contentStyle={{
                        background: "var(--bg-card)",
                        border: "1px solid var(--border-color)",
                        borderRadius: 10,
                        color: "var(--text-primary)",
                      }}
                    />

                    <Legend
                      verticalAlign="bottom"
                      iconType="circle"
                      formatter={(value) => (
                        <span className="dash-chart-legend">{value}</span>
                      )}
                    />
                  </PieChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              </div>

              <div className="dash-outcome-summary">
                <div>
                  <span>Successful</span>
                  <strong className="text-success">
                    {drillSummary.successful}
                  </strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Failed</span>
                  <strong className="text-danger">{drillSummary.failed}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span>Attention</span>
                  <strong className="text-warning">
                    {drillSummary.attention}
                  </strong>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              icon={Activity}
              title="No drill outcomes recorded"
              description={
                canViewRecovery
                  ? "Recovery drill results will appear here."
                  : "This information requires an Admin or Auditor account."
              }
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* INFRASTRUCTURE */}
      <section className="dash-section">
        <SectionHeading
          eyebrow="INFRASTRUCTURE"
          title="Storage and regional evidence"
          description="Regional verification results from the latest recorded disaster recovery drill."
        />

        <div className="dash-region-grid">
          <RegionCard
            region="IN"
            name="Mumbai"
            code="AWS ap-south-1"
            verification={latestDrill?.primary_verified}
            verifiedAt={latestDrillDate}
          />

          <div className="dash-replication-connector">
            <div className="dash-connector-line" />
            <div className="dash-connector-icon">
              <ArrowRight size={18} />
            </div>
            <strong>Cross-region replication</strong>
            <span>Primary → Secondary</span>
            <div className="dash-connector-line" />
          </div>

          <RegionCard
            region="SG"
            name="Singapore"
            code="AWS ap-southeast-1"
            verification={latestDrill?.secondary_verified}
            verifiedAt={latestDrillDate}
            secondary
          />
        </div>

        <div className="dash-region-footnote">
          <AlertTriangle size={15} />
          These are historical verification results, not a live S3 availability
          or replication health check.
          {latestDrillDate && (
            <span> Latest drill: {formatDate(latestDrillDate)}</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* REPLICATION SUMMARY */}
      {canViewRecovery && (
        <section className="dash-section">
          <SectionHeading
            eyebrow="REPLICATION"
            title="Replication observations"
            description="Recorded replication outcomes from recovery metrics."
          />

          <div className="dash-replication-grid">
            <div className="dash-replication-card">
              <div className="dash-replication-icon tone-green">
                <CheckCircle2 size={20} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <span>Completed observations</span>
                <strong>{metricSummary.replicationCompleted}</strong>

            </div>

            <div className="dash-replication-card">
              <div className="dash-replication-icon tone-red">

                <span>Failed observations</span>

            </div>

            <div className="dash-replication-card">
              <div className="dash-replication-icon tone-blue">
                <HardDrive size={20} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <span>Recorded observations</span>
                <strong>{metricSummary.replicationObserved}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="dash-replication-card">
              <div className="dash-replication-icon tone-purple">
                <Users size={20} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <span>Registered users</span>
                <strong>{formatNumber(system?.totalUsers)}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <p className="dash-footnote">
            Replication observations are historical measurements. They do not

      )}

      {/* RECENT DOCUMENTS */}
      <section className="dash-section">
        <SectionHeading
          eyebrow="DOCUMENT ACTIVITY"

                      <StatusPill status={document.status} />

        {dashboard?.errors?.documents && (

        )}
      </section>

      {/* RECENT RECOVERY ACTIVITY */}
      {canViewRecovery && (

            eyebrow="OPERATIONS HISTORY"
            title="Recent recovery activity"

              <Link to="/recovery" className="dash-text-link">

              <tbody>
                {drills.length ? (
                  [...drills]
                    .sort(
                      (a, b) => new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at),
                    )
                    .slice(0, 8)
                    .map((drill, index) => (
                      <tr key={drill.id ?? `${drill.document_id}-${index}`}>
                        <td>#{drill.document_id ?? "—"}</td>

                          {String(drill.failure_type || "DRILL")
                            .replaceAll("_", " ")

                          <StatusPill
                            status={
                              drill.primary_verified === true
                                ? "VERIFIED"
                                : drill.primary_verified === false
                                  ? "FAILED"
                                  : "UNKNOWN"
                            }
                          />

                        <td>
                          <StatusPill
                            status={
                              drill.secondary_verified === true
                                ? "VERIFIED"
                                : drill.secondary_verified === false
                                  ? "FAILED"
                                  : "UNKNOWN"
                            }

                        <td>
                          <StatusPill status={drill.drill_status} />
                        </td>

                          {formatSeconds(
                            drill.rto_seconds ??

                          )}

                )}

            </table>
          </div>

          {dashboard?.errors?.drills && (
            <p className="dash-section-error">

            </p>
          )}
        </section>
      )}

      {/* LATEST MANIFEST */}
      {canViewRecovery && (
        <section className="dash-section">
          <SectionHeading
            eyebrow="RECOVERY EVIDENCE"
            title="Latest recovery manifest"
            description="Portable evidence created by the recovery workflow."
          />

          {latestManifest ? (

                <FileCheck2 size={25} />
              </div>

              <div className="dash-manifest-main">
                <strong>
                  {latestManifest.manifest_id || "Recovery manifest"}

                  Document #{latestManifest.document_id} ·{" "}
                  {String(latestManifest.failure_type || "Recovery")
                    .replaceAll("_", " ")
                    .toLowerCase()}
                </span>

                <small>Created {formatDate(latestManifest.created_at)}</small>
              </div>

              <div className="dash-manifest-result">
                <StatusPill status={latestManifest.verification_status} />
                <strong>{formatSeconds(latestManifest.rto_seconds)}</strong>
                <small>Recorded RTO</small>
              </div>
            </article>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              icon={FileCheck2}
              title="No recovery manifests available"
              description="A recovery manifest will be recorded after a successful recovery operation."
            />
          )}
        </section>
      )}

      {/* SYSTEM DETAILS AND QUICK ACTIONS */}
      <section className="dash-bottom-grid">
        <div className="dash-panel">
          <SectionHeading
            eyebrow="SYSTEM INFORMATION"
            title="Environment summary"
            description="Information reported by the application backend."
          />

          <div className="dash-info-list">
            <div>
              <span>Application</span>
              <strong>
                <StatusPill status={system?.application || "UNKNOWN"} />
              </strong>
            </div>

            <div>
              <span>Database</span>
              <strong>
                <StatusPill status={system?.database || "UNKNOWN"} />
              </strong>
            </div>

            <div>
              <span>Registered users</span>
              <strong>{formatNumber(system?.totalUsers)}</strong>
            </div>

            <div>
              <span>Configured roles</span>
              <strong>{formatNumber(system?.totalRoles)}</strong>
            </div>

            <div>
              <span>Current account</span>
              <strong>{user?.username || "—"}</strong>
            </div>

            <div>
              <span>Access role</span>
              <strong>{user?.roles?.join(", ") || "—"}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          {system?.message && <p className="dash-footnote">{system.message}</p>}

          {dashboard?.errors?.system && (
            <p className="dash-section-error">
              System information unavailable: {dashboard.errors.system}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="dash-panel">
          <SectionHeading
            eyebrow="SHORTCUTS"
            title="Quick actions"
            description="Go directly to frequently used areas."
          />

          <div className="dash-quick-actions">
            <Link to="/documents">
              <span className="quick-action-icon tone-blue">
                <Files size={19} />
              </span>
              <span>
                <strong>Manage documents</strong>
                <small>Upload, preview and organize files</small>
              </span>
              <ArrowUpRight size={17} />
            </Link>

            <Link to="/recovery">
              <span className="quick-action-icon tone-green">
                <ShieldCheck size={19} />
              </span>
              <span>
                <strong>Disaster recovery</strong>
                <small>Verify documents and run recovery drills</small>
              </span>
              <ArrowUpRight size={17} />
            </Link>

            <Link to="/audit">
              <span className="quick-action-icon tone-purple">
                <FileClock size={19} />
              </span>
              <span>
                <strong>Audit trail</strong>
                <small>Review document activity and history</small>
              </span>
              <ArrowUpRight size={17} />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <footer className="dash-footer">
        <span>EvidenceVault · Multi-Region Document Evidence System</span>
        <span>
          Dashboard data is fetched from the connected application services.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";

import {
  Search,
  Upload,
  Download,
  Eye,
  Trash2,
  RotateCcw,
  FileText,
  FileImage,
  File,
  RefreshCw,
  X,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  FolderOpen,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
} from "lucide-react";

import {
  getDocuments,
  uploadDocument,
  deleteDocument,
  restoreDocument,
  downloadDocument,
} from "../services/documentService";

import {
  formatFileSize,
  formatDocumentDate,
  getFileExtension,
  isPreviewable,
  getDocumentStatus,

import "../styles/documents.css";

const PAGE_SIZE = 10;

const EMPTY_FILTERS = {
  keyword: "",
  category: "",
  status: "",
};

// --------------------------------------------------
// Document icon
// --------------------------------------------------

function DocumentIcon({ contentType }) {
  if (contentType?.startsWith("image/")) {
    return <FileImage size={20} />;
  }

  if (contentType === "application/pdf") {
    return <FileText size={20} />;
  }

  return <File size={20} />;
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// Document status
// --------------------------------------------------

function DocumentStatus({ status }) {
  const value = getDocumentStatus(status);

  const className =
    value === "ACTIVE" || value === "AVAILABLE"
      ? "document-status-active"
      : value === "DELETED"
        ? "document-status-deleted"
        : "document-status-neutral";

  return (
    <span className={`document-status ${className}`}>
      {value.replaceAll("_", " ")}
    </span>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// Upload modal
// --------------------------------------------------

function UploadModal({ onClose, onUpload, uploading }) {
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState("");

  function handleSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (!file) {
      setValidationError("Please select a document.");
      return;
    }

    if (!category.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Please enter a document category.");
      return;
    }

    setValidationError("");

    onUpload(file, category.trim(), description.trim());
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="document-modal-overlay"
      onClick={uploading ? undefined : onClose}
    >
      <section
        className="document-modal"
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="upload-modal-title"
      >
        <div className="modal-heading">
          <div>
            <h2 id="upload-modal-title">Upload document</h2>
            <p>Add a new document to your evidence vault.</p>
          </div>

          <button
            className="icon-button"
            onClick={onClose}
            type="button"
            disabled={uploading}
            aria-label="Close upload modal"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <label className="document-form-label">Select document</label>

          <label className="file-drop-area">
            <Upload size={28} />

            <strong>{file ? file.name : "Choose a file to upload"}</strong>

            <span>
              {file
                ? formatFileSize(file.size)
                : "Select a file from your computer"}
            </span>

            <input
              type="file"
              onChange={(event) => {
                setFile(event.target.files?.[0] || null);
                setValidationError("");
              }}
              disabled={uploading}
            />
          </label>

          <label className="document-form-label">
            Category <span>*</span>
          </label>

          <input
            className="document-input"
            type="text"
            placeholder="e.g. Legal, Financial, Reports"
            value={category}
            onChange={(event) => setCategory(event.target.value)}
            required
            disabled={uploading}
          />

          <label className="document-form-label">Description</label>

          <textarea
            className="document-input document-textarea"
            placeholder="Enter a short description..."
            value={description}
            onChange={(event) => setDescription(event.target.value)}
            rows={3}
            disabled={uploading}
          />

          {validationError && (
            <p className="document-validation-error">{validationError}</p>
          )}

          <div className="modal-actions">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="secondary-button"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={uploading}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="document-primary-button"
              disabled={uploading}
            >
              <Upload size={16} />
              {uploading ? "Uploading..." : "Upload document"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// Preview modal
// --------------------------------------------------

function PreviewModal({ document, previewUrl, previewText, onClose }) {
  const contentType = document.contentType?.toLowerCase() || "";

  const isImage = contentType.startsWith("image/");
  const isText =
    contentType.startsWith("text/") ||
    contentType === "application/json" ||
    contentType === "application/xml";

  return (
    <div className="document-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <section
        className="document-preview-modal"
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="preview-modal-title"
      >
        <div className="modal-heading">
          <div>
            <h2 id="preview-modal-title">{document.originalFilename}</h2>

            <p>Document preview</p>
          </div>

          <button
            className="icon-button"
            onClick={onClose}
            type="button"
            aria-label="Close preview"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {isImage ? (
          <div className="image-preview-area">
            <img src={previewUrl} alt={document.originalFilename} />
          </div>
        ) : isText ? (
          <div className="text-preview-area">
            <pre>{previewText}</pre>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <iframe
            className="pdf-preview-frame"
            src={previewUrl}
            title={document.originalFilename}
          />
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// Main Documents component
// --------------------------------------------------

export default function Documents() {
  // Document data
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState([]);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(0);
  const [totalElements, setTotalElements] = useState(0);

  // Draft filters: values currently entered by the user
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");

  // Applied filters: values actually sent to the backend
  const [appliedFilters, setAppliedFilters] = useState({
    ...EMPTY_FILTERS,
  });

  // Loading and action states
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [actionId, setActionId] = useState(null);

  // Modal states
  const [showUpload, setShowUpload] = useState(false);

  const [selectedPreviewDocument, setSelectedPreviewDocument] = useState(null);

  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState("");
  const [previewText, setPreviewText] = useState("");

  // Alert states
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // Tracks the latest list request.
  // This prevents an older response from replacing newer data.
  const requestSequence = useRef(0);

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Load documents
  // --------------------------------------------------

  const loadDocuments = useCallback(
    async (overrides = {}) => {
      const requestId = ++requestSequence.current;

      const requestPage = overrides.page ?? page;

      const requestFilters = overrides.filters ?? appliedFilters;

      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const result = await getDocuments({
          keyword: requestFilters.keyword,
          category: requestFilters.category,
          status: requestFilters.status,
          page: requestPage,
          size: PAGE_SIZE,
        });

        // Ignore an outdated response.
        if (requestId !== requestSequence.current) {
          return;
        }

        setDocuments(Array.isArray(result?.content) ? result.content : []);

        setTotalPages(result?.totalPages ?? 0);
        setTotalElements(result?.totalElements ?? 0);
      } catch (err) {
        if (requestId !== requestSequence.current) {
          return;
        }

        setError(err?.message || "Unable to load documents.");

        setDocuments([]);
        setTotalPages(0);
        setTotalElements(0);
      } finally {
        if (requestId === requestSequence.current) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [page, appliedFilters],
  );

  // Automatically load when the page or applied filters change.
  useEffect(() => {
    loadDocuments();
  }, [loadDocuments]);

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Preview URL cleanup
  // --------------------------------------------------

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (previewUrl) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
      }
    };
  }, [previewUrl]);

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Active documents summary
  // --------------------------------------------------

  const activeDocuments = useMemo(() => {
    return documents.filter(
      (item) => getDocumentStatus(item.status) !== "DELETED",
    );
  }, [documents]);

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Upload document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handleUpload(file, selectedCategory, description) {
    setUploading(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      await uploadDocument(file, selectedCategory, description);

      setShowUpload(false);

      // Reset the filters after a successful upload.
      setKeyword("");
      setCategory("");
      setStatus("");

      setAppliedFilters({
        ...EMPTY_FILTERS,
      });

      setPage(0);

      setMessage("Document uploaded successfully.");

      // Explicitly refresh page 0 with empty filters.
      await loadDocuments({
        page: 0,
        filters: EMPTY_FILTERS,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Document upload failed.");
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Download document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handleDownload(document) {
    setActionId(document.id);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    let downloadUrl = "";

    try {
      const blob = await downloadDocument(document.id);

      if (!(blob instanceof Blob) || blob.size === 0) {
        throw new Error("The downloaded document is empty.");
      }

      downloadUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

      const link = window.document.createElement("a");

      link.href = downloadUrl;
      link.download = document.originalFilename || "document";

      window.document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      link.remove();

      setMessage("Document download started.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Download failed.");
    } finally {
      if (downloadUrl) {
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadUrl);
        }, 1000);
      }

      setActionId(null);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Preview document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handlePreview(document) {
    if (!isPreviewable(document.contentType, document.originalFilename)) {
      setError(
        "Preview is not supported for this file type. You can download the document instead.",
      );

      return;
    }

    setActionId(document.id);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const blob = await downloadDocument(document.id);

      if (!(blob instanceof Blob) || blob.size === 0) {
        throw new Error("The preview response is empty.");
      }

      const contentType = document.contentType?.toLowerCase() || "";

      const isText =
        contentType.startsWith("text/") ||
        contentType === "application/json" ||
        contentType === "application/xml";

      // Text and CSV files are displayed as text.
      if (isText) {
        const text = await blob.text();

        setPreviewUrl("");
        setPreviewText(text);
        setSelectedPreviewDocument(document);
      } else {
        // PDF and image files use a temporary object URL.
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

        setPreviewText("");
        setPreviewUrl(url);
        setSelectedPreviewDocument(document);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Unable to preview document.");
    } finally {
      setActionId(null);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Close preview
  // --------------------------------------------------

  function closePreview() {
    setSelectedPreviewDocument(null);
    setPreviewUrl("");
    setPreviewText("");
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Delete document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handleDelete(document) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to delete "${document.originalFilename}"?`,
    );

    if (!confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    setActionId(document.id);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      await deleteDocument(document.id);

      setMessage("Document deleted successfully.");

      // If the deleted document was the only record
      // on the current page, move to the previous page.
      if (documents.length === 1 && page > 0) {
        setPage((current) => current - 1);
      } else {
        await loadDocuments();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Unable to delete document.");
    } finally {
      setActionId(null);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Restore document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handleRestore(document) {
    setActionId(document.id);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      await restoreDocument(document.id);

      setMessage("Document restored successfully.");

      await loadDocuments();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Unable to restore document.");
    } finally {
      setActionId(null);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Search and filters
  // --------------------------------------------------

  function applySearch(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setAppliedFilters({
      keyword: keyword.trim(),
      category: category.trim(),
      status,
    });

    setPage(0);
  }

  function clearFilters() {
    setKeyword("");
    setCategory("");
    setStatus("");

    setAppliedFilters({
      ...EMPTY_FILTERS,
    });

    setPage(0);
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Refresh
  // --------------------------------------------------

  function handleRefresh() {
    loadDocuments();
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Render
  // --------------------------------------------------

  return (
    <main className="documents-page">
      {/* Page heading */}

      <section className="documents-heading">
        <div>
          <span className="documents-eyebrow">EVIDENCE VAULT</span>

          <h1>Document Management</h1>

          <p>Upload, organize, preview and manage your protected documents.</p>
        </div>

        <button
          className="document-primary-button"
          onClick={() => setShowUpload(true)}
          type="button"
        >
          <Upload size={17} />
          Upload document
        </button>
      </section>

      {/* Summary cards */}

      <section className="document-summary-grid">
        <div className="document-summary-card">
          <div className="document-summary-icon">
            <FolderOpen size={21} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Total records</span>
            <strong>{totalElements}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="document-summary-card">
          <div className="document-summary-icon summary-green">
            <CheckCircle2 size={21} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Active on this page</span>
            <strong>{activeDocuments.length}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="document-summary-card">
          <div className="document-summary-icon summary-purple">
            <FileText size={21} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Current page</span>

            <strong>
              {totalPages > 0 ? page + 1 : 0} / {totalPages}
            </strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Success message */}

      {message && (
        <div className="document-alert document-alert-success">
          <CheckCircle2 size={17} />

          <span>{message}</span>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMessage("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss success message"
          >
            <X size={15} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Error message */}

      {error && (
        <div className="document-alert document-alert-error">
          <AlertCircle size={17} />

          <span>{error}</span>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setError("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss error message"
          >
            <X size={15} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search and filters */}

      <section className="document-toolbar">
        <form className="document-search-form" onSubmit={applySearch}>
          <div className="document-search-box">
            <Search size={18} />

            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search document name..."
              value={keyword}
              onChange={(event) => setKeyword(event.target.value)}
            />
          </div>

          <input
            className="document-filter-input"
            type="text"
            placeholder="Category"
            value={category}
            onChange={(event) => setCategory(event.target.value)}
          />

          <select
            className="document-filter-input"
            value={status}
            onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">All statuses</option>
            <option value="ACTIVE">Active</option>
            <option value="DELETED">Deleted</option>
          </select>

          <button
            type="submit"
            className="document-search-button"
            disabled={loading}
          >
            Search
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="document-clear-button"
            onClick={clearFilters}
          >
            Clear
          </button>
        </form>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="document-refresh-button"
          onClick={handleRefresh}
          disabled={loading}
          title="Refresh documents"
          aria-label="Refresh documents"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={17} className={loading ? "documents-spin" : ""} />
        </button>
      </section>

      {/* Documents table */}

      <section className="documents-table-card">
        <div className="documents-table-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>Your documents</h2>

            <p>
              Showing {documents.length} of {totalElements} records
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Loading state */}

        {loading ? (
          <div className="documents-empty-state">
            <RefreshCw className="documents-spin" size={25} />

            <p>Loading documents...</p>
          </div>
        ) : documents.length === 0 ? (
          /* Empty state */

          <div className="documents-empty-state">
            <FolderOpen size={35} />

            <h3>No documents found</h3>

            <p>Try changing your search filters or upload a new document.</p>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="document-primary-button"
              onClick={() => setShowUpload(true)}
            >
              <Upload size={16} />
              Upload document
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Table */

          <div className="documents-table-scroll">
            <table className="documents-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Document</th>
                  <th>Category</th>
                  <th>Size</th>
                  <th>Checksum</th>
                  <th>Status</th>
                  <th>Uploaded by</th>
                  <th>Upload date</th>
                  <th>Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody>
                {documents.map((document) => {
                  const deleted =
                    getDocumentStatus(document.status) === "DELETED";

                  const rowLoading = actionId === document.id;

                  return (
                    <tr key={document.id}>
                      {/* Document name */}

                      <td>
                        <div className="document-name-cell">
                          <div className="document-file-icon">
                            <DocumentIcon contentType={document.contentType} />
                          </div>

                          <div>
                            <strong>{document.originalFilename}</strong>

                            <span>
                              {getFileExtension(document.originalFilename)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Category */}

                      <td>{document.category || "N/A"}</td>

                      {/* File size */}

                      <td>{formatFileSize(document.fileSizeBytes)}</td>

                      {/* Checksum */}

                      <td>
                        <span
                          className="checksum-value"
                          title={document.sha256Checksum || ""}
                        >
                          {document.sha256Checksum
                            ? `${document.sha256Checksum.slice(0, 12)}...`
                            : "N/A"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Status */}

                      <td>
                        <DocumentStatus status={document.status} />
                      </td>

                      {/* Uploaded by */}

                      <td>{document.uploadedBy || "N/A"}</td>

                      {/* Upload date */}

                      <td>{formatDocumentDate(document.createdAt)}</td>

                      {/* Actions */}

                      <td>
                        <div className="document-row-actions">
                          {!deleted && (
                            <>
                              {/* Preview */}

                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Preview"
                                aria-label={`Preview ${document.originalFilename}`}
                                disabled={
                                  rowLoading ||
                                  !isPreviewable(
                                    document.contentType,
                                    document.originalFilename,
                                  )
                                }
                                onClick={() => handlePreview(document)}
                              >
                                <Eye size={16} />
                              </button>

                              {/* Download */}

                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Download"
                                aria-label={`Download ${document.originalFilename}`}
                                disabled={rowLoading}
                                onClick={() => handleDownload(document)}
                              >
                                <Download size={16} />
                              </button>

                              {/* Delete */}

                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Delete"
                                aria-label={`Delete ${document.originalFilename}`}
                                className="delete-action"
                                disabled={rowLoading}
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(document)}
                              >
                                <Trash2 size={16} />
                              </button>
                            </>
                          )}

                          {/* Restore */}

                          {deleted && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              title="Restore"
                              aria-label={`Restore ${document.originalFilename}`}
                              className="restore-action"
                              disabled={rowLoading}
                              onClick={() => handleRestore(document)}
                            >
                              <RotateCcw size={16} />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Pagination */}

        <div className="documents-pagination">
          <span>
            Page {totalPages > 0 ? page + 1 : 0} of {totalPages}
          </span>

          <div>
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={page <= 0 || loading}
              onClick={() => setPage((current) => current - 1)}
            >
              <ChevronLeft size={17} />
              Previous
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={loading || totalPages === 0 || page >= totalPages - 1}
              onClick={() => setPage((current) => current + 1)}
            >
              Next
              <ChevronRight size={17} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Upload modal */}

      {showUpload && (
        <UploadModal
          onClose={() => setShowUpload(false)}
          onUpload={handleUpload}
          uploading={uploading}
        />
      )}

      {/* Preview modal */}

      {selectedPreviewDocument && (
        <PreviewModal
          document={selectedPreviewDocument}
          previewUrl={previewUrl}
          previewText={previewText}
          onClose={closePreview}
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";

import {
  ShieldCheck,
  User,
  Lock,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  ArrowRight,
  AlertCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAuth } from "../context/AuthContext";

import "../styles/login.css";

function Login() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const { login, loading } = useAuth();

  const [credentials, setCredentials] = useState({
    username: "",
    password: "",
  });

  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const handleChange = (event) => {
    const { name, value } = event.target;

    setCredentials((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [name]: value,
    }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    if (!credentials.username.trim() || !credentials.password) {
      setError("Please enter both username and password.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      await login(credentials);

      const destination = location.state?.from?.pathname || "/dashboard";

      navigate(destination, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Login failed. Please try again.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="login-page">
      <div className="login-decoration"></div>

      <div className="login-container">
        <div className="login-brand-icon">
          <ShieldCheck size={38} />
        </div>

        <div className="login-heading">
          <h1>Welcome Back</h1>

          <p>Sign in to access your secure evidence vault.</p>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="login-error">
            <AlertCircle size={17} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="username">Username</label>

            <div className="input-wrapper">
              <User size={18} />

              <input
                id="username"
                name="username"
                type="text"
                placeholder="Enter your username"
                value={credentials.username}
                onChange={handleChange}
                autoComplete="username"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>

            <div className="input-wrapper">
              <Lock size={18} />

              <input
                id="password"
                name="password"
                type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                placeholder="Enter your password"
                value={credentials.password}
                onChange={handleChange}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                required
              />

              <button
                type="button"
                className="password-toggle"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword((previous) => !previous)}
                aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button type="submit" className="login-submit" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? "Signing In..." : "Sign In"}

            {!loading && <ArrowRight size={18} />}
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="login-security">
          <ShieldCheck size={15} />

          <span>Secure authentication powered by JWT</span>
        </div>

        <Link to="/" className="back-home">
          Back to Home
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default Login;
