import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";

import {
  Search,
  Upload,
  Download,
  Eye,
  Trash2,
  RotateCcw,
  FileText,
  FileImage,
  File,
  RefreshCw,
  X,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  FolderOpen,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
} from "lucide-react";

import {
  getDocuments,
  uploadDocument,
  deleteDocument,
  restoreDocument,
  downloadDocument,
  previewDocument,
} from "../services/documentService";

import {
  formatFileSize,
  formatDocumentDate,
  getFileExtension,
  isPreviewable,
  getDocumentStatus,
} from "../services/documentUtils";

import "../styles/documents.css";

const PAGE_SIZE = 10;

const EMPTY_FILTERS = {
  keyword: "",
  category: "",
  status: "",
};

// --------------------------------------------------
// Document icon
// --------------------------------------------------

function DocumentIcon({ contentType }) {
  if (contentType?.startsWith("image/")) {
    return <FileImage size={20} />;
  }

  if (contentType === "application/pdf") {
    return <FileText size={20} />;
  }

  return <File size={20} />;
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// Document status
// --------------------------------------------------

function DocumentStatus({ status }) {
  const value = getDocumentStatus(status);

  const className =
    value === "ACTIVE" || value === "AVAILABLE"
      ? "document-status-active"
      : value === "DELETED"
        ? "document-status-deleted"
        : "document-status-neutral";

  return (
    <span className={`document-status ${className}`}>
      {value.replaceAll("_", " ")}
    </span>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// Upload modal
// --------------------------------------------------

function UploadModal({ onClose, onUpload, uploading }) {
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [validationError, setValidationError] = useState("");

  function handleSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (!file) {
      setValidationError("Please select a document.");
      return;
    }

    if (!category.trim()) {
      setValidationError("Please enter a document category.");
      return;
    }

    setValidationError("");

    onUpload(file, category.trim(), description.trim());
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="document-modal-overlay"
      onClick={uploading ? undefined : onClose}
    >
      <section
        className="document-modal"
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="upload-modal-title"
      >
        <div className="modal-heading">
          <div>
            <h2 id="upload-modal-title">Upload document</h2>
            <p>Add a new document to your evidence vault.</p>
          </div>

          <button
            className="icon-button"
            onClick={onClose}
            type="button"
            disabled={uploading}
            aria-label="Close upload modal"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <label className="document-form-label">Select document</label>

          <label className="file-drop-area">
            <Upload size={28} />

            <strong>{file ? file.name : "Choose a file to upload"}</strong>

            <span>
              {file
                ? formatFileSize(file.size)
                : "Select a file from your computer"}
            </span>

            <input
              type="file"
              onChange={(event) => {
                setFile(event.target.files?.[0] || null);
                setValidationError("");
              }}
              disabled={uploading}
            />
          </label>

          <label className="document-form-label">
            Category <span>*</span>
          </label>

          <input
            className="document-input"
            type="text"
            placeholder="e.g. Legal, Financial, Reports"
            value={category}
            onChange={(event) => setCategory(event.target.value)}
            required
            disabled={uploading}
          />

          <label className="document-form-label">Description</label>

          <textarea
            className="document-input document-textarea"
            placeholder="Enter a short description..."
            value={description}
            onChange={(event) => setDescription(event.target.value)}
            rows={3}
            disabled={uploading}
          />

          {validationError && (
            <p className="document-validation-error">{validationError}</p>
          )}

          <div className="modal-actions">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="secondary-button"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={uploading}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="document-primary-button"
              disabled={uploading}
            >
              <Upload size={16} />
              {uploading ? "Uploading..." : "Upload document"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// Preview modal
// --------------------------------------------------

function PreviewModal({ document, previewUrl, previewText, onClose }) {
  const contentType = document.contentType?.toLowerCase() || "";

  const isImage = contentType.startsWith("image/");
  const isText =
    contentType.startsWith("text/") ||
    contentType === "application/json" ||
    contentType === "application/xml";

  return (
    <div className="document-modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <section
        className="document-preview-modal"
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="preview-modal-title"
      >
        <div className="modal-heading">
          <div>
            <h2 id="preview-modal-title">{document.originalFilename}</h2>

            <p>Document preview</p>
          </div>

          <button
            className="icon-button"
            onClick={onClose}
            type="button"
            aria-label="Close preview"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {isImage ? (
          <div className="image-preview-area">
            <img src={previewUrl} alt={document.originalFilename} />
          </div>
        ) : isText ? (
          <div className="text-preview-area">
            <pre>{previewText}</pre>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <iframe
            className="pdf-preview-frame"
            src={previewUrl}
            title={document.originalFilename}
          />
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// Main Documents component
// --------------------------------------------------

export default function Documents() {
  // Document data
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState([]);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(0);
  const [totalElements, setTotalElements] = useState(0);

  // Draft filters: values currently entered by the user
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("");

  // Applied filters: values actually sent to the backend
  const [appliedFilters, setAppliedFilters] = useState({
    ...EMPTY_FILTERS,
  });

  // Loading and action states
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [actionId, setActionId] = useState(null);

  // Modal states
  const [showUpload, setShowUpload] = useState(false);

  const [selectedPreviewDocument, setSelectedPreviewDocument] = useState(null);

  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState("");
  const [previewText, setPreviewText] = useState("");

  // Alert states
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // Tracks the latest list request.
  // This prevents an older response from replacing newer data.
  const requestSequence = useRef(0);

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Load documents
  // --------------------------------------------------

  const loadDocuments = useCallback(
    async (overrides = {}) => {
      const requestId = ++requestSequence.current;

      const requestPage = overrides.page ?? page;

      const requestFilters = overrides.filters ?? appliedFilters;

      setLoading(true);
      setError("");

      try {
        const result = await getDocuments({
          keyword: requestFilters.keyword,
          category: requestFilters.category,
          status: requestFilters.status,
          page: requestPage,
          size: PAGE_SIZE,
        });

        // Ignore an outdated response.
        if (requestId !== requestSequence.current) {
          return;
        }

        setDocuments(Array.isArray(result?.content) ? result.content : []);

        setTotalPages(result?.totalPages ?? 0);
        setTotalElements(result?.totalElements ?? 0);
      } catch (err) {
        if (requestId !== requestSequence.current) {
          return;
        }

        setError(err?.message || "Unable to load documents.");

        setDocuments([]);
        setTotalPages(0);
        setTotalElements(0);
      } finally {
        if (requestId === requestSequence.current) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [page, appliedFilters],
  );

  // Automatically load when the page or applied filters change.
  useEffect(() => {
    loadDocuments();
  }, [loadDocuments]);

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Preview URL cleanup
  // --------------------------------------------------

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (previewUrl) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl);
      }
    };
  }, [previewUrl]);

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Active documents summary
  // --------------------------------------------------

  const activeDocuments = useMemo(() => {
    return documents.filter(
      (item) => getDocumentStatus(item.status) !== "DELETED",
    );
  }, [documents]);

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Upload document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handleUpload(file, selectedCategory, description) {
    setUploading(true);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      await uploadDocument(file, selectedCategory, description);

      setShowUpload(false);

      // Reset the filters after a successful upload.
      setKeyword("");
      setCategory("");
      setStatus("");

      setAppliedFilters({
        ...EMPTY_FILTERS,
      });

      setPage(0);

      setMessage("Document uploaded successfully.");

      // Explicitly refresh page 0 with empty filters.
      await loadDocuments({
        page: 0,
        filters: EMPTY_FILTERS,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Document upload failed.");
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Download document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handleDownload(document) {
    setActionId(document.id);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    let downloadUrl = "";

    try {
      const blob = await downloadDocument(document.id);

      if (!(blob instanceof Blob) || blob.size === 0) {
        throw new Error("The downloaded document is empty.");
      }

      downloadUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

      const link = window.document.createElement("a");

      link.href = downloadUrl;
      link.download = document.originalFilename || "document";

      window.document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      link.remove();

      setMessage("Document download started.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Download failed.");
    } finally {
      if (downloadUrl) {
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(downloadUrl);
        }, 1000);
      }

      setActionId(null);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Preview document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handlePreview(document) {
    if (!isPreviewable(document.contentType, document.originalFilename)) {
      setError(
        "Preview is not supported for this file type. You can download the document instead.",
      );

      return;
    }

    setActionId(document.id);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const blob = await previewDocument(document.id);

      if (!(blob instanceof Blob) || blob.size === 0) {
        throw new Error("The preview response is empty.");
      }

      const contentType = document.contentType?.toLowerCase() || "";

      const isText =
        contentType.startsWith("text/") ||
        contentType === "application/json" ||
        contentType === "application/xml";

      // Text and CSV files are displayed as text.
      if (isText) {
        const text = await blob.text();

        setPreviewUrl("");
        setPreviewText(text);
        setSelectedPreviewDocument(document);
      } else {
        // PDF and image files use a temporary object URL.
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

        setPreviewText("");
        setPreviewUrl(url);
        setSelectedPreviewDocument(document);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Unable to preview document.");
    } finally {
      setActionId(null);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Close preview
  // --------------------------------------------------

  function closePreview() {
    setSelectedPreviewDocument(null);
    setPreviewUrl("");
    setPreviewText("");
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Delete document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handleDelete(document) {
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to delete "${document.originalFilename}"?`,
    );

    if (!confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    setActionId(document.id);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      await deleteDocument(document.id);

      setMessage("Document deleted successfully.");

      // If the deleted document was the only record
      // on the current page, move to the previous page.
      if (documents.length === 1 && page > 0) {
        setPage((current) => current - 1);
      } else {
        await loadDocuments();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Unable to delete document.");
    } finally {
      setActionId(null);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Restore document
  // --------------------------------------------------

  async function handleRestore(document) {
    setActionId(document.id);
    setError("");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      await restoreDocument(document.id);

      setMessage("Document restored successfully.");

      await loadDocuments();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err?.message || "Unable to restore document.");
    } finally {
      setActionId(null);
    }
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Search and filters
  // --------------------------------------------------

  function applySearch(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    setAppliedFilters({
      keyword: keyword.trim(),
      category: category.trim(),
      status,
    });

    setPage(0);
  }

  function clearFilters() {
    setKeyword("");
    setCategory("");
    setStatus("");

    setAppliedFilters({
      ...EMPTY_FILTERS,
    });

    setPage(0);
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Refresh
  // --------------------------------------------------

  function handleRefresh() {
    loadDocuments();
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // Render
  // --------------------------------------------------

  return (
    <main className="documents-page">
      {/* Page heading */}

      <section className="documents-heading">
        <div>
          <span className="documents-eyebrow">EVIDENCE VAULT</span>

          <h1>Document Management</h1>

          <p>Upload, organize, preview and manage your protected documents.</p>
        </div>

        <button
          className="document-primary-button"
          onClick={() => setShowUpload(true)}
          type="button"
        >
          <Upload size={17} />
          Upload document
        </button>
      </section>

      {/* Summary cards */}

      <section className="document-summary-grid">
        <div className="document-summary-card">
          <div className="document-summary-icon">
            <FolderOpen size={21} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Total records</span>
            <strong>{totalElements}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="document-summary-card">
          <div className="document-summary-icon summary-green">
            <CheckCircle2 size={21} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Active on this page</span>
            <strong>{activeDocuments.length}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="document-summary-card">
          <div className="document-summary-icon summary-purple">
            <FileText size={21} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Current page</span>

            <strong>
              {totalPages > 0 ? page + 1 : 0} / {totalPages}
            </strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Success message */}

      {message && (
        <div className="document-alert document-alert-success">
          <CheckCircle2 size={17} />

          <span>{message}</span>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMessage("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss success message"
          >
            <X size={15} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Error message */}

      {error && (
        <div className="document-alert document-alert-error">
          <AlertCircle size={17} />

          <span>{error}</span>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setError("")}
            aria-label="Dismiss error message"
          >
            <X size={15} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search and filters */}

      <section className="document-toolbar">
        <form className="document-search-form" onSubmit={applySearch}>
          <div className="document-search-box">
            <Search size={18} />

            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search document name..."
              value={keyword}
              onChange={(event) => setKeyword(event.target.value)}
            />
          </div>

          <input
            className="document-filter-input"
            type="text"
            placeholder="Category"
            value={category}
            onChange={(event) => setCategory(event.target.value)}
          />

          <select
            className="document-filter-input"
            value={status}
            onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">All statuses</option>
            <option value="ACTIVE">Active</option>
            <option value="DELETED">Deleted</option>
          </select>

          <button
            type="submit"
            className="document-search-button"
            disabled={loading}
          >
            Search
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            className="document-clear-button"
            onClick={clearFilters}
          >
            Clear
          </button>
        </form>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="document-refresh-button"
          onClick={handleRefresh}
          disabled={loading}
          title="Refresh documents"
          aria-label="Refresh documents"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={17} className={loading ? "documents-spin" : ""} />
        </button>
      </section>

      {/* Documents table */}

      <section className="documents-table-card">
        <div className="documents-table-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>Your documents</h2>

            <p>
              Showing {documents.length} of {totalElements} records
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Loading state */}

        {loading ? (
          <div className="documents-empty-state">
            <RefreshCw className="documents-spin" size={25} />

            <p>Loading documents...</p>
          </div>
        ) : documents.length === 0 ? (
          /* Empty state */

          <div className="documents-empty-state">
            <FolderOpen size={35} />

            <h3>No documents found</h3>

            <p>Try changing your search filters or upload a new document.</p>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="document-primary-button"
              onClick={() => setShowUpload(true)}
            >
              <Upload size={16} />
              Upload document
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Table */

          <div className="documents-table-scroll">
            <table className="documents-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Document</th>
                  <th>Category</th>
                  <th>Size</th>
                  <th>Checksum</th>
                  <th>Status</th>
                  <th>Uploaded by</th>
                  <th>Upload date</th>
                  <th>Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody>
                {documents.map((document) => {
                  const deleted =
                    getDocumentStatus(document.status) === "DELETED";

                  const rowLoading = actionId === document.id;

                  return (
                    <tr key={document.id}>
                      {/* Document name */}

                      <td>
                        <div className="document-name-cell">
                          <div className="document-file-icon">
                            <DocumentIcon contentType={document.contentType} />
                          </div>

                          <div>
                            <strong>{document.originalFilename}</strong>

                            <span>
                              {getFileExtension(document.originalFilename)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Category */}

                      <td>{document.category || "N/A"}</td>

                      {/* File size */}

                      <td>{formatFileSize(document.fileSizeBytes)}</td>

                      {/* Checksum */}

                      <td>
                        <span
                          className="checksum-value"
                          title={document.sha256Checksum || ""}
                        >
                          {document.sha256Checksum
                            ? `${document.sha256Checksum.slice(0, 12)}...`
                            : "N/A"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Status */}

                      <td>
                        <DocumentStatus status={document.status} />
                      </td>

                      {/* Uploaded by */}

                      <td>{document.uploadedBy || "N/A"}</td>

                      {/* Upload date */}

                      <td>{formatDocumentDate(document.createdAt)}</td>

                      {/* Actions */}

                      <td>
                        <div className="document-row-actions">
                          {!deleted && (
                            <>
                              {/* Preview */}

                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Preview"
                                aria-label={`Preview ${document.originalFilename}`}
                                disabled={
                                  rowLoading ||
                                  !isPreviewable(
                                    document.contentType,
                                    document.originalFilename,
                                  )
                                }
                                onClick={() => handlePreview(document)}
                              >
                                <Eye size={16} />
                              </button>

                              {/* Download */}

                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Download"
                                aria-label={`Download ${document.originalFilename}`}
                                disabled={rowLoading}
                                onClick={() => handleDownload(document)}
                              >
                                <Download size={16} />
                              </button>

                              {/* Delete */}

                              <button
                                type="button"
                                title="Delete"
                                aria-label={`Delete ${document.originalFilename}`}
                                className="delete-action"
                                disabled={rowLoading}
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(document)}
                              >
                                <Trash2 size={16} />
                              </button>
                            </>
                          )}

                          {/* Restore */}

                          {deleted && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              title="Restore"
                              aria-label={`Restore ${document.originalFilename}`}
                              className="restore-action"
                              disabled={rowLoading}
                              onClick={() => handleRestore(document)}
                            >
                              <RotateCcw size={16} />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Pagination */}

        <div className="documents-pagination">
          <span>
            Page {totalPages > 0 ? page + 1 : 0} of {totalPages}
          </span>

          <div>
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={page <= 0 || loading}
              onClick={() => setPage((current) => current - 1)}
            >
              <ChevronLeft size={17} />
              Previous
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={loading || totalPages === 0 || page >= totalPages - 1}
              onClick={() => setPage((current) => current + 1)}
            >
              Next
              <ChevronRight size={17} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Upload modal */}

      {showUpload && (
        <UploadModal
          onClose={() => setShowUpload(false)}
          onUpload={handleUpload}
          uploading={uploading}
        />
      )}

      {/* Preview modal */}

      {selectedPreviewDocument && (
        <PreviewModal
          document={selectedPreviewDocument}
          previewUrl={previewUrl}
          previewText={previewText}
          onClose={closePreview}
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";

import {
  ShieldCheck,
  User,
  Lock,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  ArrowRight,
  AlertCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

import { Link, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAuth } from "../context/AuthContext";

import "../styles/login.css";

function Login() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const { login, loading } = useAuth();

  const [credentials, setCredentials] = useState({
    username: "",
    password: "",
  });

  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const handleChange = (event) => {
    const { name, value } = event.target;

    setCredentials((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      [name]: value,
    }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    if (!credentials.username.trim() || !credentials.password) {
      setError("Please enter both username and password.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      await login(credentials);

      const destination = location.state?.from?.pathname || "/dashboard";

      navigate(destination, { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Login failed. Please try again.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="login-page">
      <div className="login-decoration"></div>

      <div className="login-container">
        <div className="login-brand-icon">
          <ShieldCheck size={38} />
        </div>

        <div className="login-heading">
          <h1>Welcome Back</h1>

          <p>Sign in to access your secure evidence vault.</p>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="login-error">
            <AlertCircle size={17} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="username">Username</label>

            <div className="input-wrapper">
              <User size={18} />

              <input
                id="username"
                name="username"
                type="text"
                placeholder="Enter your username"
                value={credentials.username}
                onChange={handleChange}
                autoComplete="username"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>

            <div className="input-wrapper">
              <Lock size={18} />

              <input
                id="password"
                name="password"
                type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                placeholder="Enter your password"
                value={credentials.password}
                onChange={handleChange}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                required
              />

              <button
                type="button"
                className="password-toggle"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword((previous) => !previous)}
                aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button type="submit" className="login-submit" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? "Signing In..." : "Sign In"}

            {!loading && <ArrowRight size={18} />}
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="login-security">
          <ShieldCheck size={15} />

          <span>Secure authentication powered by JWT</span>
        </div>

        <Link to="/" className="back-home">
          Back to Home
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default Login;

const API_BASE_URL = "/api";

async function readResponseBody(response) {
  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";

  try {
    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
      return await response.json();
    }

    return await response.text();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Converts backend errors into readable messages.
 * Never exposes raw JSON or internal 500-level details.
 */
export function createApiErrorMessage(
  response,
  responseData,
  fallback = "Something went wrong. Please try again.",
  endpoint = "",
) {
  const status = response.status;

  if (status === 401) {
    if (endpoint.includes("/auth/login")) {
      return "Invalid username or password. Please check your credentials and try again.";
    }

    return "Your session has expired. Please sign in again.";
  }

  if (status === 403) {
    return "You do not have permission to perform this action.";
  }

  if (status === 404) {
    return "The requested resource could not be found.";
  }

  if (status === 413) {
    return "The selected file is too large to upload.";
  }

  if (status >= 500) {
    return fallback;
  }

  if (typeof responseData === "string" && responseData.trim()) {
    return responseData;
  }

  if (responseData && typeof responseData === "object") {
    return (
      responseData.detail ||
      responseData.message ||
      responseData.error ||
      responseData.title ||
      fallback
    );
  }

  return fallback;
}

/**
 * Reads an error response from an API call.
 * Also used by binary document preview/download requests.
 */
export async function getApiErrorMessage(response, fallback, endpoint = "") {
  const responseData = await readResponseBody(response);

  return createApiErrorMessage(response, responseData, fallback, endpoint);
}

/**
 * Common API request function.
 */
export async function apiRequest(endpoint, options = {}) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-token");

  const headers = {
    ...options.headers,
  };

  if (
    options.body !== undefined &&
    !(options.body instanceof FormData) &&
    !headers["Content-Type"]
  ) {
    headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  }

  if (token) {
    headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }

  let response;

  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${endpoint}`, {
      ...options,
      headers,
    });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      "Unable to connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.",
    );
  }

  if (response.status === 204) {
    return null;
  }

  const responseData = await readResponseBody(response);

  if (!response.ok) {
    const fallback =
      response.status >= 500
        ? "The server couldn't complete your request. Please try again later."
        : "The request could not be completed.";

    const message = createApiErrorMessage(
      response,
      responseData,
      fallback,
      endpoint,
    );

    throw new Error(message);
  }

  return responseData;
}

import { apiRequest } from "./api";

export async function loginUser(credentials) {
  const response = await apiRequest("/v1/auth/login", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      username: credentials.username,
      password: credentials.password,
    }),
  });

  return response;
}

export function saveAuthSession(authData) {
  localStorage.setItem("evidence-vault-token", authData.accessToken);

  localStorage.setItem(
    "evidence-vault-user",
    JSON.stringify({
      username: authData.username,
      roles: authData.roles,
      tokenType: authData.tokenType,
      expiresIn: authData.expiresIn,
    }),
  );
}

export function getStoredUser() {
  const storedUser = localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-user");

  if (!storedUser) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(storedUser);
  } catch {
    clearAuthSession();
    return null;
  }
}

export function clearAuthSession() {
  localStorage.removeItem("evidence-vault-token");
  localStorage.removeItem("evidence-vault-user");
}

import { apiRequest } from "./api";

export async function getSystemStatus() {
  return apiRequest("/v1/system/status");
}

export async function getRecoveryMetrics() {
  return apiRequest("/v1/dr/metrics");
}

export async function getDrillHistory() {
  return apiRequest("/v1/dr/drills");
}

export async function getRecoveryManifests() {
  return apiRequest("/v1/dr/manifests");
}

export async function getDocumentSummary() {
  return apiRequest("/v1/documents?page=0&size=1");
}

export async function getDashboardData() {
  const requests = await Promise.allSettled([
    getSystemStatus(),
    getRecoveryMetrics(),
    getDrillHistory(),
    getRecoveryManifests(),
    getDocumentSummary(),
  ]);

  const getValue = (index, fallback) =>
    requests[index].status === "fulfilled" ? requests[index].value : fallback;

  const getError = (index) =>
    requests[index].status === "rejected"
      ? requests[index].reason?.message || "Request failed"
      : null;

  return {
    system: getValue(0, null),
    metrics: getValue(1, []),
    drills: getValue(2, []),
    manifests: getValue(3, []),
    documents: getValue(4, null),

    errors: {
      system: getError(0),
      metrics: getError(1),
      drills: getError(2),
      manifests: getError(3),
      documents: getError(4),
    },
  };
}

export function normalizeArray(data) {
  return Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
}
export function average(values) {
  const valid = values
    .filter((value) => value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== "")
    .map(Number)
    .filter(Number.isFinite);

  if (!valid.length) return null;

  return Number(
    (valid.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / valid.length).toFixed(3),
  );
}

export function calculateDrillSummary(drills) {
  const total = drills.length;

  const successful = drills.filter(
    (item) => item.drill_status === "SUCCESS",
  ).length;

  const failed = drills.filter((item) => item.drill_status === "FAILED").length;

  const attentionRequired = drills.filter(
    (item) => item.drill_status === "RECOVERY_REQUIRED",
  ).length;

  const recoveryOperations = drills.filter(
    (item) => item.recovery_performed === true,
  ).length;

  const corruptionDrills = drills.filter(
    (item) =>
      item.corruption_detected === true ||
      item.failure_type === "SIMULATED_CORRUPTION",
  ).length;

  const primaryFailures = drills.filter(
    (item) => item.failure_type === "SIMULATED_PRIMARY_FAILURE",
  ).length;

  const checksumMismatches = drills.filter((item) => {
    const primaryMismatch =
      item.primary_checksum &&
      item.expected_checksum &&
      item.primary_checksum !== item.expected_checksum;

    const secondaryMismatch =
      item.secondary_checksum &&
      item.expected_checksum &&
      item.secondary_checksum !== item.expected_checksum;

    return primaryMismatch || secondaryMismatch;
  }).length;

  return {
    total,
    successful,
    failed,
    attentionRequired,
    recoveryOperations,
    corruptionDrills,
    primaryFailures,
    checksumMismatches,

    successRate: total ? Number(((successful / total) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null,
  };
}

export function calculateMetricSummary(metrics) {
  const rtoValues = metrics.map(
    (item) => item.recovery_rto_seconds ?? item.recovery_workflow_seconds,
  );

  const rpoValues = metrics
    .map((item) => item.estimated_rpo_seconds)
    .filter((value) => value !== null && value !== undefined);

  const replicationCompleted = metrics.filter(
    (item) => item.replication_status === "COMPLETED",
  ).length;

  const replicationFailed = metrics.filter(
    (item) => item.replication_status === "FAILED",
  ).length;

  const replicationTimedOut = metrics.filter(
    (item) => item.replication_timed_out === true,
  ).length;

  return {
    averageRto: average(rtoValues),
    averageRpo: average(rpoValues),
    replicationCompleted,
    replicationFailed,
    replicationTimedOut,
  };
}

export function getLatestRecord(records) {
  if (!records.length) return null;

  return [...records].sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at),
  )[0];
}

export function formatSeconds(value) {
  if (
    value === null ||
    value === undefined ||
    !Number.isFinite(Number(value))
  ) {
    return "N/A";
  }

  return `${Number(value).toFixed(3)} sec`;
}

export function formatPercentage(value) {
  return value === null || value === undefined ? "N/A" : `${value}%`;
}

export function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return "N/A";

  const date = new Date(value);

  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? "N/A" : date.toLocaleString();
}

import { APP_CONFIG } from "../config/constants";

const API_BASE_URL = APP_CONFIG.API_BASE_URL;

function getFriendlyError(status) {
  switch (status) {
    case 401:
      return "Your session has expired. Please sign in again.";
    case 403:
      return "You don't have permission to access this document.";
    case 404:
      return "The document could not be found.";
    case 500:
      return "The server couldn't retrieve this document. Please try again.";
    default:
      return "Unable to retrieve the document. Please try again.";
  }
}

export async function fetchDocumentBlob(documentId) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-token");

  if (!token) {
    throw new Error("Your session has expired. Please sign in again.");
  }

  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_BASE_URL}/v1/documents/${documentId}/download`,
    {
      method: "GET",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
    },
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    let message = getFriendlyError(response.status);

    try {
      const errorData = await response.json();

      // Don't expose raw server exceptions to the UI.
      if (response.status >= 500) {
        message =
          "The server couldn't retrieve this document. Please try again.";
      } else if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
        message = getFriendlyError(response.status);
      } else if (errorData.message) {
        message = errorData.message;
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep the friendly fallback message.
    }

    throw new Error(message);
  }

  return await response.blob();
}

export function downloadBlob(blob, filename) {
  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = objectUrl;
  link.download = filename || "document";
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
}

import { apiRequest } from "./api";
import { APP_CONFIG } from "../config/constants";

const DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT = "/v1/documents";
const API_BASE_URL = APP_CONFIG.API_BASE_URL;

function getAuthToken() {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-token");

  if (!token) {
    throw new Error("Your session has expired. Please sign in again.");
  }

  return token;
}

async function getErrorMessage(response, action) {
  const messages = {
    400: "The document request is invalid.",
    401: "Your session has expired. Please sign in again.",
    403: "You don't have permission to access this document.",
    404: "The requested document was not found.",
    409: "The document cannot be processed in its current state.",
    500: "The server encountered an error while retrieving the document.",
    502: "The storage service is temporarily unavailable.",
    503: "The document service is temporarily unavailable.",
  };

  const fallback =
    messages[response.status] ||
    `Unable to ${action} the document. HTTP ${response.status}.`;

  try {
    const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";

    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
      const data = await response.json();

      // Prefer a useful application-level message.
      return (
        data.message ||
        data.detail ||
        data.error ||
        fallback
      );
    }

    const text = await response.text();

    return text.trim() || fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// GET DOCUMENTS
// --------------------------------------------------

export async function getDocuments({
  keyword = "",
  category = "",
  status = "",
  page = 0,
  size = 10,
} = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    page: String(page),
    size: String(size),
  });

  if (keyword.trim()) {
    params.set("keyword", keyword.trim());
  }

  if (category.trim()) {
    params.set("category", category.trim());
  }

  if (status.trim()) {
    params.set("status", status.trim());
  }

  return apiRequest(
    `${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}?${params.toString()}`
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// UPLOAD DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export async function uploadDocument(
  file,
  category,
  description = ""
) {
  if (!file) {
    throw new Error("Please select a document to upload.");
  }

  if (!category?.trim()) {
    throw new Error("Please provide a document category.");
  }

  const formData = new FormData();

  formData.append("file", file);
  formData.append("category", category.trim());

  if (description?.trim()) {
    formData.append("description", description.trim());
  }

  return apiRequest(`${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}/upload`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: formData,
  });
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// DELETE DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export async function deleteDocument(documentId) {
  if (!documentId) {
    throw new Error("A valid document ID is required.");
  }

  return apiRequest(`${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}/${documentId}`, {
    method: "DELETE",
  });
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// RESTORE DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export async function restoreDocument(documentId) {
  if (!documentId) {
    throw new Error("A valid document ID is required.");
  }

  return apiRequest(
    `${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}/${documentId}/restore`,
    {
      method: "POST",
    }
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// COMMON BINARY FILE REQUEST
// --------------------------------------------------

async function fetchDocumentFile(documentId, action) {
  if (!documentId) {
    throw new Error("A valid document ID is required.");
  }

  if (!["preview", "download"].includes(action)) {
    throw new Error("Unsupported document operation.");
  }

  const token = getAuthToken();

  const url =
    `${API_BASE_URL}${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}` +
    `/${encodeURIComponent(documentId)}/${action}`;

  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      Accept: "*/*",
    },
    cache: "no-store",
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = await getErrorMessage(response, action);
    throw new Error(message);
  }

  const blob = await response.blob();

  if (blob.size === 0) {
    throw new Error("The server returned an empty document.");
  }

  return blob;
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// PREVIEW DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export function previewDocument(documentId) {
  return fetchDocumentFile(documentId, "preview");
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// DOWNLOAD DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export function downloadDocument(documentId) {
  return fetchDocumentFile(documentId, "download");
}

export function formatFileSize(bytes) {
  if (bytes === null || bytes === undefined) {
    return "N/A";
  }

  const size = Number(bytes);

  if (!Number.isFinite(size) || size < 0) {
    return "N/A";
  }

  if (size === 0) {
    return "0 Bytes";
  }

  const units = ["Bytes", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];

  const index = Math.min(
    Math.floor(Math.log(size) / Math.log(1024)),
    units.length - 1,
  );

  return `${(size / Math.pow(1024, index)).toFixed(2)} ${units[index]}`;
}

export function formatDocumentDate(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return "N/A";
  }

  const date = new Date(value);

  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? "N/A" : date.toLocaleString();
}

export function getFileExtension(filename = "") {
  if (!filename || !filename.includes(".")) {
    return "FILE";
  }

  return filename.split(".").pop().toUpperCase();
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// PREVIEW ELIGIBILITY
// --------------------------------------------------

export function isPreviewable(contentType = "", filename = "") {
  const type = String(contentType).toLowerCase().split(";")[0].trim();

  const extension = String(filename).toLowerCase().split(".").pop();

  const supportedTypes = [
    "application/pdf",
    "text/plain",
    "text/csv",
    "image/png",
    "image/jpeg",
    "image/jpg",
    "image/webp",
    "image/gif",
  ];

  const supportedExtensions = [
    "pdf",
    "txt",
    "csv",
    "png",
    "jpg",
    "jpeg",
    "webp",
    "gif",
  ];

  return (
    supportedTypes.includes(type) ||
    type.startsWith("image/") ||
    supportedExtensions.includes(extension)
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// DOCUMENT STATUS
// --------------------------------------------------

export function getDocumentStatus(status) {
  return String(status || "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase();
}

FILE: App.jsx
========================================
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route } from "react-router-dom";

import { ThemeProvider } from "./context/ThemeContext";
import { AuthProvider } from "./context/AuthContext";

import { USER_ROLES } from "./config/constants";

import Layout from "./components/Layout";
import ProtectedRoute from "./components/ProtectedRoute";

import Home from "./pages/Home";
import Login from "./pages/Login";
import Dashboard from "./pages/Dashboard";
import Documents from "./pages/Documents";
import Recovery from "./pages/Recovery";
import Audit from "./pages/Audit";
import Unauthorized from "./pages/Unauthorized";

function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      <AuthProvider>
        <BrowserRouter>
          <Routes>
            <Route element={<Layout />}>
              {/* Public pages */}
              <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
              <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
              <Route path="/unauthorized" element={<Unauthorized />} />

              {/* All authenticated users */}
              <Route element={<ProtectedRoute />}>
                <Route path="/dashboard" element={<Dashboard />} />

                <Route path="/documents" element={<Documents />} />
              </Route>

              {/* Admin and Operator */}
              <Route
                element={
                  <ProtectedRoute
                    allowedRoles={[USER_ROLES.ADMIN, USER_ROLES.OPERATOR]}
                  />
                }
              >
                <Route path="/recovery" element={<Recovery />} />
              </Route>

              {/* Admin and Auditor */}
              <Route
                element={
                  <ProtectedRoute
                    allowedRoles={[USER_ROLES.ADMIN, USER_ROLES.AUDITOR]}
                  />
                }
              >
                <Route path="/audit" element={<Audit />} />
              </Route>
            </Route>
          </Routes>
        </BrowserRouter>
      </AuthProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}

export default App;

import { NavLink, Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

import {
  Sun,
  Moon,
  ShieldCheck,
  LogIn,
  LogOut,
  UserCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

import { useTheme } from "../context/ThemeContext";
import { useAuth } from "../context/AuthContext";

import { NAVIGATION_ITEMS } from "../data/navigation";

import "../styles/navbar.css";

function Navbar() {
  const { isDark, toggleTheme } = useTheme();

  const { user, isAuthenticated, logout, hasRole } = useAuth();

  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const visibleNavigation = NAVIGATION_ITEMS.filter((item) => {
    if (item.public) {
      return true;
    }

    if (!isAuthenticated) {
      return false;
    }

    if (!item.roles) {
      return true;
    }

    return hasRole(item.roles);
  });

  const handleLogout = () => {
    logout();

    navigate("/", { replace: true });
  };

  return (
    <header className="navbar">
      <Link to="/" className="navbar-brand">
        <div className="brand-icon">
          <ShieldCheck size={23} />
        </div>

        <div className="brand-details">
          <span className="brand-name">EvidenceVault</span>

          <span className="brand-subtitle">SECURE EVIDENCE SYSTEM</span>
        </div>
      </Link>

      <nav className="navbar-links">
        {visibleNavigation.map((item) => {
          const Icon = item.icon;

          return (
            <NavLink
              key={item.path}
              to={item.path}
              end={item.path === "/"}
              className={({ isActive }) =>
                `nav-link ${isActive ? "active" : ""}`
              }
            >
              <Icon size={17} />
              <span>{item.label}</span>
            </NavLink>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      <div className="navbar-actions">
        <button
          className="theme-toggle"
          onClick={toggleTheme}
          title={isDark ? "Switch to light mode" : "Switch to dark mode"}
          aria-label="Toggle theme"
        >
          {isDark ? <Sun size={19} /> : <Moon size={19} />}
        </button>

        {isAuthenticated ? (
          <div className="user-session">
            <div className="user-info">
              <UserCircle size={18} />

              <div className="user-details">
                <span>{user.username}</span>
                <small>{user.roles?.join(", ")}</small>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              className="logout-button"
              onClick={handleLogout}
              title="Logout"
            >
              <LogOut size={17} />
              <span>Logout</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Link to="/login" className="login-button">
            <LogIn size={17} />
            <span>Sign In</span>
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

export default Navbar;

import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";

import { useAuth } from "../context/AuthContext";

function ProtectedRoute({ allowedRoles = [] }) {
  const { isAuthenticated, hasRole } = useAuth();

  const location = useLocation();

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: location }} />;
  }

  if (allowedRoles.length > 0 && !hasRole(allowedRoles)) {
    return <Navigate to="/unauthorized" replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
}

export default ProtectedRoute;

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const normalizedStatus = String(status || "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase();

  const isHealthy = [
    "UP",
    "SUCCESS",
    "COMPLETED",
    "HEALTHY",
    "RUNNING",
  ].includes(normalizedStatus);

  const isWarning = ["NOT_CHECKED", "PENDING", "IN_PROGRESS"].includes(
    normalizedStatus,
  );

  const color = isHealthy ? "success" : isWarning ? "warning" : "danger";

  return (
    <span className={`status-badge ${color}`}>
      <span className="status-indicator"></span>
      {normalizedStatus.replaceAll("_", " ")}
    </span>
  );
}

export default StatusBadge;

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import {
  loginUser,
  saveAuthSession,
  getStoredUser,
  clearAuthSession,
} from "../services/authService";

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(() => getStoredUser());

  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(() =>
    Boolean(localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-token") && getStoredUser()),
  );

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // Restore the saved session on application startup.
  useEffect(() => {
    const storedUser = getStoredUser();
    const storedToken = localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-token");

    if (storedUser && storedToken) {
      setUser(storedUser);
      setIsAuthenticated(true);
    } else {
      clearAuthSession();
      setUser(null);
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const login = async (credentials) => {
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const authData = await loginUser(credentials);

      if (!authData?.accessToken) {
        throw new Error("Authentication token was not received.");
      }

      saveAuthSession(authData);

      setUser({
        username: authData.username,
        roles: authData.roles || [],
        tokenType: authData.tokenType,
        expiresIn: authData.expiresIn,
      });

      setIsAuthenticated(true);

      return authData;
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const logout = () => {
    clearAuthSession();

    setUser(null);
    setIsAuthenticated(false);
  };

  const hasRole = (allowedRoles = []) => {
    if (!user || !Array.isArray(user.roles)) {
      return false;
    }

    return allowedRoles.some((role) => user.roles.includes(role));
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        isAuthenticated,
        loading,
        login,
        logout,
        hasRole,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useAuth() {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useAuth must be used inside AuthProvider");
  }

  return context;
}

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";

const ThemeContext = createContext(null);

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-theme") || "dark";
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);

    localStorage.setItem("evidence-vault-theme", theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setTheme((currentTheme) => (currentTheme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"));
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider
      value={{
        theme,
        toggleTheme,
        isDark: theme === "dark",
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider");
  }

  return context;
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  ShieldCheck,
  Clock,
  User,
  FileText,
  AlertCircle,
} from "lucide-react";

import { getDocuments } from "../services/documentService";
import { getDocumentAuditHistory } from "../services/auditService";

import "../styles/audit.css";

function Audit() {
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState([]);
  const [selectedDocumentId, setSelectedDocumentId] = useState("");
  const [auditLogs, setAuditLogs] = useState([]);

  const [loadingDocuments, setLoadingDocuments] = useState(true);
  const [loadingAudit, setLoadingAudit] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");

  const loadDocuments = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingDocuments(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await getDocuments({
        page: 0,
        size: 100,
      });

      const records = response?.content || [];
      setDocuments(records);

      if (records.length > 0) {
        setSelectedDocumentId(
          (currentId) => currentId || String(records[0].id),
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Unable to load documents.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingDocuments(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadAuditHistory = useCallback(async (documentId) => {
    if (!documentId) {
      setAuditLogs([]);
      return;
    }

    setLoadingAudit(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await getDocumentAuditHistory(documentId);
      setAuditLogs(Array.isArray(response) ? response : []);
    } catch (err) {
      setAuditLogs([]);
      setError(err.message || "Unable to load audit history.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingAudit(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDocuments();
  }, [loadDocuments]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedDocumentId) {
      loadAuditHistory(selectedDocumentId);
    }
  }, [selectedDocumentId, loadAuditHistory]);

  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    const term = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return auditLogs;

    return auditLogs.filter((log) =>
      [log.username, log.action, log.details, log.documentId]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term),
    );
  }, [auditLogs, searchTerm]);

  const selectedDocument = documents.find(
    (document) => String(document.id) === selectedDocumentId,
  );

  const formatDate = (value) => {
    if (!value) return "Unknown date";

    const date = new Date(value);

    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value;

    return date.toLocaleString();
  };

  const formatAction = (action) =>
    String(action || "UNKNOWN").replaceAll("_", " ");

  const getActionClass = (action) => {
    const value = String(action || "").toUpperCase();

    if (value.includes("DELETE")) return "audit-action-delete";
    if (value.includes("RESTORE")) return "audit-action-restore";
    if (value.includes("UPLOAD")) return "audit-action-upload";
    if (value.includes("DOWNLOAD")) return "audit-action-download";
    if (value.includes("PREVIEW")) return "audit-action-preview";

    return "audit-action-default";
  };

  return (
    <main className="audit-page">
      <section className="audit-header">
        <div>
          <div className="audit-title-row">
            <ShieldCheck size={28} />
            <h1>Audit Trail</h1>
          </div>

          <p>Track document activities, users, and recorded events.</p>
        </div>

        <button
          className="audit-refresh-button"
          onClick={() => {
            if (selectedDocumentId) {
              loadAuditHistory(selectedDocumentId);
            } else {
              loadDocuments();
            }
          }}
          disabled={loadingAudit || loadingDocuments}
        >
          <RefreshCw size={16} />
          Refresh
        </button>
      </section>

      <section className="audit-controls">
        <div className="audit-document-selector">
          <label htmlFor="audit-document">Select Document</label>

          <select
            id="audit-document"
            value={selectedDocumentId}
            onChange={(event) => setSelectedDocumentId(event.target.value)}
            disabled={loadingDocuments || documents.length === 0}
          >
            {documents.length === 0 && (
              <option value="">No documents available</option>
            )}

            {documents.map((document) => (
              <option key={document.id} value={String(document.id)}>
                #{document.id} — {document.originalFilename}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="audit-search">
          <Search size={17} />

          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search user, action or details..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(event) => setSearchTerm(event.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      </section>

      {selectedDocument && (
        <section className="audit-document-card">
          <div className="audit-document-icon">
            <FileText size={22} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <h3>{selectedDocument.originalFilename}</h3>
            <p>
              Document ID: #{selectedDocument.id}
              {" · "}
              Category: {selectedDocument.category}
              {" · "}
              Status: {selectedDocument.status}
            </p>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="audit-error">
          <AlertCircle size={18} />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <section className="audit-summary">
        <div className="audit-summary-icon">
          <Activity size={21} />
        </div>

        <div>
          <span>Total Recorded Events</span>
          <strong>{auditLogs.length}</strong>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="audit-history-section">
        <div className="audit-section-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>Activity History</h2>
            <p>Events are displayed in newest-first order.</p>
          </div>

          <span className="audit-event-count">
            {filteredLogs.length} events
          </span>
        </div>

        {loadingDocuments || loadingAudit ? (
          <div className="audit-state">
            <RefreshCw className="audit-spin" size={24} />
            <p>Loading audit history...</p>
          </div>
        ) : filteredLogs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="audit-state">
            <FileText size={32} />
            <h3>No audit events found</h3>
            <p>
              {auditLogs.length === 0
                ? "No recorded activities are available for this document."
                : "Try a different search term."}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="audit-table-wrapper">
            <table className="audit-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Event ID</th>
                  <th>Action</th>
                  <th>User</th>
                  <th>Details</th>
                  <th>Timestamp</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody>
                {filteredLogs.map((log) => (
                  <tr key={log.id}>
                    <td>#{log.id}</td>

                    <td>
                      <span
                        className={`audit-action ${getActionClass(log.action)}`}
                      >
                        {formatAction(log.action)}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td>
                      <span className="audit-user">
                        <User size={15} />
                        {log.username}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td>{log.details || "—"}</td>

                    <td>
                      <span className="audit-time">
                        <Clock size={14} />
                        {formatDate(log.createdAt)}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

export default Audit;

function StatCard({ title, value, subtitle, icon: Icon, tone = "blue" }) {

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const normalized = String(status || "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase();

  let className = "status-neutral";

  if (["SUCCESS", "COMPLETED", "UP", "VERIFIED"].includes(normalized)) {
    className = "status-success";
  } else if (["FAILED", "DOWN", "ERROR", "MISMATCH"].includes(normalized)) {
    className = "status-danger";
  } else if (["RECOVERY_REQUIRED", "PENDING", "WARNING"].includes(normalized)) {
    className = "status-warning";
  }

  return (
    <span className={`status-badge ${className}`}>
      {normalized.replaceAll("_", " ")}
    </span>
  );
}

function EmptyState({ message }) {
  return <div className="dashboard-empty">{message}</div>;
}

export default function Dashboard() {
  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [pageError, setPageError] = useState("");

  const loadDashboard = useCallback(async (isRefresh = false) => {
    if (isRefresh) {
      setRefreshing(true);
    } else {
      setLoading(true);
    }

    setPageError("");

    try {
      const result = await getDashboardData();
      setDashboard(result);
    } catch (error) {
      setPageError(error?.message || "Unable to load dashboard data.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboard();
  }, [loadDashboard]);

  const metrics = useMemo(
    () => normalizeArray(dashboard?.metrics),
    [dashboard],
  );

  const drills = useMemo(() => normalizeArray(dashboard?.drills), [dashboard]);

  const manifests = useMemo(
    () => normalizeArray(dashboard?.manifests),
    [dashboard],
  );

  const drillSummary = useMemo(() => calculateDrillSummary(drills), [drills]);

  const metricSummary = useMemo(
    () => calculateMetricSummary(metrics),
    [metrics],
  );

  const latestDrill = useMemo(() => getLatestRecord(drills), [drills]);

  const latestManifest = useMemo(() => getLatestRecord(manifests), [manifests]);

  const documentCount = dashboard?.documents?.totalElements ?? 0;
  const userCount = dashboard?.system?.totalUsers ?? "N/A";

  const rtoChartData = useMemo(() => {
    return [...metrics]
      .filter(
        (item) =>
          item.recovery_rto_seconds !== null &&
          item.recovery_rto_seconds !== undefined,
      )
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at))
      .slice(-8)
      .map((item, index) => ({
        name: formatDate(item.created_at),
        rto: Number(item.recovery_rto_seconds),
        label: `Drill ${index + 1}`,
      }));
  }, [metrics]);

  const drillChartData = [
    { name: "Successful", value: drillSummary.successful },
    { name: "Failed", value: drillSummary.failed },
    { name: "Attention required", value: drillSummary.attentionRequired },
  ].filter((item) => item.value > 0);

  const latestFailureType =
    latestDrill?.failure_type?.replaceAll("_", " ") || "No drill recorded";

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="dashboard-loading">
        <RefreshCw className="loading-spin" size={25} />
        <p>Loading your dashboard...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (pageError && !dashboard) {
    return (
      <div className="dashboard-error">
        <AlertTriangle size={30} />
        <h2>Dashboard could not be loaded</h2>
        <p>{pageError}</p>
        <button onClick={() => loadDashboard()}>
          <RefreshCw size={16} /> Try again
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const system = dashboard?.system;

  return (
    <main className="dashboard-page">
      {/* Dashboard heading */}
      <section className="dashboard-heading">
        <div>
          <span className="dashboard-eyebrow">DOCUMENT EVIDENCE VAULT</span>

          <h1>Dashboard</h1>

          <p>
            Monitor document protection, regional verification and disaster
            recovery performance.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          className="refresh-button"
          onClick={() => loadDashboard(true)}
          disabled={refreshing}
        >
          <RefreshCw size={17} className={refreshing ? "loading-spin" : ""} />
          {refreshing ? "Refreshing..." : "Refresh"}
        </button>
      </section>

      {pageError && (
        <div className="dashboard-warning">
          <AlertTriangle size={17} />
          Some dashboard information could not be refreshed. Check the
          individual sections below.
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Infrastructure health */}
      <section className="dashboard-section">
        <div className="section-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>Infrastructure overview</h2>
            <p>Application and database status</p>
          </div>
          <Activity size={20} />
        </div>

        <div className="infrastructure-grid">
          <div className="infrastructure-card">
            <div className="infrastructure-icon">
              <Cloud size={22} />
            </div>

            <div>
              <span>Spring Boot application</span>
              <StatusBadge status={system?.application || "UNKNOWN"} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="infrastructure-card">
            <div className="infrastructure-icon">
              <Database size={22} />
            </div>

            <div>
              <span>MySQL database</span>
              <StatusBadge status={system?.database || "UNKNOWN"} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="infrastructure-card">
            <div className="infrastructure-icon">
              <Users size={22} />
            </div>

            <div>
              <span>Registered users</span>
              <strong>{userCount}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="infrastructure-card">
            <div className="infrastructure-icon">
              <FileText size={22} />
            </div>

            <div>
              <span>Stored document records</span>
              <strong>{documentCount}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {system?.message && <p className="system-message">{system.message}</p>}

        {dashboard?.errors?.system && (
          <p className="section-error">
            Infrastructure status unavailable: {dashboard.errors.system}
          </p>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* Main KPI cards */}
      <section className="dashboard-section">
        <div className="section-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>Disaster recovery performance</h2>
            <p>Measurements from recorded recovery operations</p>
          </div>
          <ShieldCheck size={20} />
        </div>

        <div className="dashboard-stats-grid">
          <StatCard
            title="Total DR drills"
            value={drillSummary.total}
            subtitle="Recorded drill operations"
            icon={Activity}
            tone="blue"
          />

          <StatCard
            title="Drill success rate"
            value={
              drillSummary.successRate === null
                ? "N/A"
                : `${drillSummary.successRate}%`
            }
            subtitle={`${drillSummary.successful} successful drills`}
            icon={CheckCircle2}
            tone="green"
          />

          <StatCard
            title="Average recovery time"
            value={formatSeconds(metricSummary.averageRto)}
            subtitle="Average recorded RTO"
            icon={Clock3}
            tone="purple"
          />

          <StatCard
            title="Average estimated RPO"
            value={formatSeconds(metricSummary.averageRpo)}
            subtitle="Timestamp-based estimate"
            icon={ArrowDownToLine}
            tone="orange"
          />

          <StatCard
            title="Recovery operations"
            value={drillSummary.recoveryOperations}
            subtitle="Drills where recovery was performed"
            icon={RefreshCw}
            tone="blue"
          />

          <StatCard
            title="Recovery manifests"
            value={manifests.length}
            subtitle="Recorded recovery evidence"
            icon={FileCheck2}
            tone="green"
          />
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Regional verification */}
      <section className="dashboard-section">
        <div className="section-heading">
          <div>

            <p>
              Results from the most recently recorded DR drill. These are not
              live S3 health checks.

        <div className="region-grid">
          <div className="region-card">
            <div className="region-top">
              <div className="region-icon">IN</div>
              <div>
                <h3>Primary region</h3>
                <span>Mumbai · ap-south-1</span>
              </div>

            <div className="region-result">
              <span>Last recorded verification</span>
              <StatusBadge
                status={
                  latestDrill?.primary_verified === true
                    ? "VERIFIED"

            <div className="region-top">
              <div className="region-icon region-icon-secondary">SG</div>

                <h3>Secondary region</h3>
                <span>Singapore · ap-southeast-1</span>
              </div>

            <div className="region-result">
              <span>Last recorded verification</span>

                  latestDrill?.secondary_verified === true
