import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Cloud,
  Database,
  FileText,
  RefreshCw,
  ShieldCheck,
  XCircle,
  Zap,
} from "lucide-react";

import { useAuth } from "../context/AuthContext";
import { USER_ROLES } from "../config/constants";

import { getDocuments } from "../services/documentService";
import {
  getDrillHistory,
  getRecoveryManifests,
} from "../services/dashboardService";

import {
  verifyDocument,
  runRecoveryDrill,
  simulatePrimaryFailure,
  simulateCorruption,
} from "../services/recoveryService";

import "../styles/recovery.css";

function Recovery() {
  const { hasRole } = useAuth();
  const isAdmin = hasRole([USER_ROLES.ADMIN]);

  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState([]);
  const [selectedDocumentId, setSelectedDocumentId] = useState("");

  const [history, setHistory] = useState([]);
  const [manifests, setManifests] = useState([]);

  const [verification, setVerification] = useState(null);
  const [operationResult, setOperationResult] = useState(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [working, setWorking] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const loadInitialData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const documentResponse = await getDocuments({
        page: 0,
        size: 100,
      });

      const records = documentResponse?.content || [];
      setDocuments(records);

      if (records.length > 0) {
        setSelectedDocumentId((current) => current || String(records[0].id));
      }

      // Only Admin can access these read-only endpoints.
      if (isAdmin) {
        const results = await Promise.allSettled([
          getDrillHistory(),
          getRecoveryManifests(),
        ]);

        setHistory(
          results[0].status === "fulfilled" && Array.isArray(results[0].value)
            ? results[0].value
            : [],
        );

        setManifests(
          results[1].status === "fulfilled" && Array.isArray(results[1].value)
            ? results[1].value
            : [],
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Unable to load recovery data.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [isAdmin]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadInitialData();
  }, [loadInitialData]);

  const refreshHistory = async () => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;

    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      getDrillHistory(),
      getRecoveryManifests(),
    ]);

    if (results[0].status === "fulfilled") {
      setHistory(Array.isArray(results[0].value) ? results[0].value : []);
    }

    if (results[1].status === "fulfilled") {
      setManifests(Array.isArray(results[1].value) ? results[1].value : []);
    }
  };

  const executeOperation = async (operation, confirmation) => {
    if (!selectedDocumentId || working) return;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(confirmation);

    if (!confirmed) return;

    setWorking(true);
    setError("");
    setOperationResult(null);

    try {
      const result = await operation(Number(selectedDocumentId));

      setOperationResult(result);

      // Refresh the read-only verification and history after the action.
      const verified = await verifyDocument(Number(selectedDocumentId));

      setVerification(verified);

      await refreshHistory();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Recovery operation failed.");
    } finally {
      setWorking(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVerify = async () => {
    if (!selectedDocumentId || working) return;

    setWorking(true);
    setError("");
    setOperationResult(null);

    try {
      const result = await verifyDocument(Number(selectedDocumentId));

      setVerification(result);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Document verification failed.");
      setVerification(null);
    } finally {
      setWorking(false);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (value) => {
    if (!value) return "—";

    const date = new Date(value);

    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? value : date.toLocaleString();
  };

  const formatSeconds = (value) => {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) return "—";
    return `${Number(value).toFixed(3)} sec`;
  };

  const selectedDocument = documents.find(
    (document) => String(document.id) === selectedDocumentId,
  );

  const primary = verification?.primary;
  const secondary = verification?.secondary;

  const Status = ({ value }) => {
    const healthy = value === true;

    return (
      <span className={`recovery-status ${healthy ? "healthy" : "unhealthy"}`}>
        {healthy ? <CheckCircle2 size={15} /> : <XCircle size={15} />}
        {healthy ? "Verified" : "Not verified"}
      </span>
    );
  };

  const drill = operationResult?.drill || operationResult;

  return (
    <main className="recovery-page">
      <header className="recovery-header">
        <div>
          <div className="recovery-title">
            <ShieldCheck size={29} />
            <h1>Disaster Recovery</h1>
          </div>

          <p>
            Verify regional replicas and execute controlled recovery drills.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          className="recovery-refresh"
          onClick={loadInitialData}
          disabled={loading || working}
        >
          <RefreshCw size={16} />
          Refresh
        </button>
      </header>

      <section className="recovery-region-grid">
        <article className="recovery-region-card">
          <div className="recovery-region-icon">
            <Cloud size={23} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Primary Region</span>
            <h3>Mumbai</h3>
            <p>ap-south-1</p>
          </div>
        </article>

        <article className="recovery-region-card">
          <div className="recovery-region-icon secondary-region-icon">
            <Database size={23} />
          </div>

          <div>
            <span>Secondary Region</span>
            <h3>Singapore</h3>
            <p>ap-southeast-1</p>
          </div>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="recovery-selector-card">
        <label htmlFor="recovery-document">Select Document</label>

        <div className="recovery-selector-row">
          <select
            id="recovery-document"
            value={selectedDocumentId}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setSelectedDocumentId(event.target.value);
              setVerification(null);
              setOperationResult(null);
              setError("");
            }}
            disabled={loading || documents.length === 0 || working}
          >
            {documents.length === 0 && (
              <option value="">No documents available</option>
            )}

            {documents.map((document) => (
              <option key={document.id} value={String(document.id)}>
                #{document.id} — {document.originalFilename}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <button
            className="recovery-verify-button"
            onClick={handleVerify}
            disabled={!selectedDocumentId || working || loading}
          >
            <ShieldCheck size={16} />
            Verify
          </button>
        </div>

        {selectedDocument && (
          <p className="recovery-selected-info">
            <FileText size={15} />
            {selectedDocument.originalFilename}
            {" · "}
            {selectedDocument.category}
            {" · "}
            {selectedDocument.status}
          </p>
        )}
      </section>

      {error && (
        <div className="recovery-error">
          <AlertCircle size={18} />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {working && (
        <div className="recovery-working">
          <RefreshCw className="recovery-spin" size={19} />
          Recovery operation is running. Please wait...
        </div>
      )}

      <section className="recovery-verification">
        <div className="recovery-section-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>Regional Verification</h2>
            <p>Integrity status of the selected document.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="recovery-verification-grid">
          <article className="recovery-verification-card">
            <Cloud size={23} />
            <h3>Mumbai — Primary</h3>
            <Status value={primary?.verified === true} />

            {primary && (
              <>
                <p>Object exists: {String(primary.exists)}</p>
                <p>Checksum verified: {String(primary.checksum_verified)}</p>
                <p>Size verified: {String(primary.size_verified)}</p>
              </>
            )}
          </article>

          <article className="recovery-verification-card">
            <Database size={23} />
            <h3>Singapore — Secondary</h3>
            <Status value={secondary?.verified === true} />

            {secondary && (
              <>

                <p>Size verified: {String(secondary.size_verified)}</p>

import { APP_CONFIG } from "../config/constants";

const API_BASE_URL = APP_CONFIG.API_BASE_URL;

async function readResponseBody(response) {
  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";

  try {
    // Handles application/json and application/problem+json.
    if (contentType.toLowerCase().includes("json")) {
      return await response.json();
    }

    return await response.text();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function extractMessage(data) {
  if (!data) return "";

  if (typeof data === "string") {
    const trimmed = data.trim();

    // Avoid showing a JSON response as raw text.
    if (trimmed.startsWith("{") || trimmed.startsWith("[")) {
      try {
        return extractMessage(JSON.parse(trimmed));
      } catch {
        return trimmed;
      }
    }

    return trimmed;
  }

  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
    return data
      .map((item) => {
        if (typeof item === "string") return item;
        return item?.defaultMessage || item?.message || "";
      })
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(", ");
  }

  if (typeof data === "object") {
    const detail = data.detail;

    if (typeof detail === "string") return detail;

    if (Array.isArray(detail)) {
      return extractMessage(detail);
    }

    return (
      data.message ||
      data.error ||
      data.title ||
      ""
    );
  }

  return "";
}

export function createApiErrorMessage(
  response,
  responseData,
  endpoint = "",
  customFallback = ""
) {
  const status = response.status;

  if (status === 401) {
    if (endpoint.includes("/auth/login")) {
      return "Invalid username or password. Please check your credentials and try again.";
    }

    return "Your session has expired. Please sign in again.";
  }

  if (status === 403) {
    return "You do not have permission to perform this action.";
  }

  if (status === 404) {
    return "The requested resource could not be found.";
  }

  if (status === 409) {
    return "This operation cannot be completed because the resource is in its current state.";
  }

  if (status === 413) {
    return "The selected file is too large to upload.";
  }

  if (status === 415) {
    return "This file format is not supported by the server.";
  }

  if (status === 422) {
    return (
      extractMessage(responseData) ||
      "Some of the submitted information is invalid. Please check your inputs."
    );
  }

  if (status >= 500) {
    return (
      customFallback ||
      "The server encountered an error. Please try again later."
    );
  }

  return (
    extractMessage(responseData) ||
    customFallback ||
    "The request could not be completed. Please try again."
  );
}

export async function getApiErrorMessage(
  response,
  fallback = "",
  endpoint = ""
) {
  const responseData = await readResponseBody(response);

  return createApiErrorMessage(
    response,
    responseData,
    endpoint,
    fallback
  );
}

export async function apiRequest(endpoint, options = {}) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-token");

  const headers = {
    ...options.headers,
  };

  const isFormData = options.body instanceof FormData;

  // JSON requests need Content-Type.
  // FormData must NOT have a manually assigned Content-Type:
  // the browser adds the multipart boundary automatically.
  if (
    options.body !== undefined &&
    !isFormData &&
    !headers["Content-Type"]
  ) {
    headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  }

  // Do not attach an old JWT to the login request.
  if (token && !endpoint.includes("/auth/login")) {
    headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }

  let response;

  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${endpoint}`, {
      ...options,
      headers,
    });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      "Unable to connect to the server. Check that the backend is running and try again."
    );
  }

  if (response.status === 204) {
    return null;
  }

  const responseData = await readResponseBody(response);

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = createApiErrorMessage(
      response,
      responseData,
      endpoint
    );

    throw new Error(message);
  }

  return responseData;
}

import { apiRequest } from "./api";

export async function loginUser(credentials) {
  const response = await apiRequest("/v1/auth/login", {
    method: "POST",
    body: JSON.stringify({
      username: credentials.username,
      password: credentials.password,
    }),
  });

  return response;
}

export function saveAuthSession(authData) {
  localStorage.setItem("evidence-vault-token", authData.accessToken);

  localStorage.setItem(
    "evidence-vault-user",
    JSON.stringify({
      username: authData.username,
      roles: authData.roles,
      tokenType: authData.tokenType,
      expiresIn: authData.expiresIn,
    }),
  );
}

export function getStoredUser() {
  const storedUser = localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-user");

  if (!storedUser) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(storedUser);
  } catch {
    clearAuthSession();
    return null;
  }
}

export function clearAuthSession() {
  localStorage.removeItem("evidence-vault-token");
  localStorage.removeItem("evidence-vault-user");
}

import { apiRequest } from "./api";

const DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT = "/v1/documents";

async function getDocumentPage({ status = "", size = 8 } = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    page: "0",
    size: String(size),
  });

  if (status) {
    params.set("status", status);
  }

  return apiRequest(`${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}?${params.toString()}`);
}

export async function getSystemStatus() {
  return apiRequest("/v1/system/status");
}

export async function getRecoveryMetrics() {
  return apiRequest("/v1/dr/metrics");
}

export async function getDrillHistory() {
  return apiRequest("/v1/dr/drills");
}

export async function getRecoveryManifests() {
  return apiRequest("/v1/dr/manifests");
}

function getSettledValue(result, fallback) {
  return result.status === "fulfilled" ? result.value : fallback;
}

function getSettledError(result) {
  return result.status === "rejected"
    ? result.reason?.message || "Unable to load this information."
    : null;
}

export async function getDashboardData({ includeRecoveryData = false } = {}) {
  const requests = await Promise.allSettled([
    getSystemStatus(),
    getDocumentPage({ size: 8 }),
    getDocumentPage({ status: "ACTIVE", size: 1 }),
    getDocumentPage({ status: "DELETED", size: 1 }),
    getDocumentPage({ status: "CORRUPTED", size: 1 }),

    includeRecoveryData ? getRecoveryMetrics() : Promise.resolve([]),
    includeRecoveryData ? getDrillHistory() : Promise.resolve([]),
    includeRecoveryData ? getRecoveryManifests() : Promise.resolve([]),
  ]);

  const [
    systemResult,
    recentDocumentsResult,
    activeDocumentsResult,
    deletedDocumentsResult,
    corruptedDocumentsResult,
    metricsResult,
    drillsResult,
    manifestsResult,
  ] = requests;

  const recentPage = getSettledValue(recentDocumentsResult, {});
  const activePage = getSettledValue(activeDocumentsResult, {});
  const deletedPage = getSettledValue(deletedDocumentsResult, {});
  const corruptedPage = getSettledValue(corruptedDocumentsResult, {});

  return {
    system: getSettledValue(systemResult, null),

    documents: {
      total: recentPage.totalElements ?? 0,
      active: activePage.totalElements ?? 0,
      deleted: deletedPage.totalElements ?? 0,
      corrupted: corruptedPage.totalElements ?? 0,

      recent: Array.isArray(recentPage.content) ? recentPage.content : [],
    },

    metrics: getSettledValue(metricsResult, []),
    drills: getSettledValue(drillsResult, []),
    manifests: getSettledValue(manifestsResult, []),

    errors: {
      system: getSettledError(systemResult),
      documents: getSettledError(recentDocumentsResult),
      activeDocuments: getSettledError(activeDocumentsResult),
      deletedDocuments: getSettledError(deletedDocumentsResult),
      corruptedDocuments: getSettledError(corruptedDocumentsResult),
      metrics: getSettledError(metricsResult),
      drills: getSettledError(drillsResult),
      manifests: getSettledError(manifestsResult),
    },

    recoveryDataEnabled: includeRecoveryData,
  };
}

export function normalizeArray(data) {
  return Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
}
export function average(values) {
  const valid = values
    .filter((value) => value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== "")
    .map(Number)
    .filter(Number.isFinite);

  if (!valid.length) return null;

  return Number(
    (valid.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / valid.length).toFixed(3),
  );
}

export function calculateDrillSummary(drills) {
  const total = drills.length;

  const successful = drills.filter(
    (item) => item.drill_status === "SUCCESS",
  ).length;

  const failed = drills.filter((item) => item.drill_status === "FAILED").length;

  const attentionRequired = drills.filter(
    (item) => item.drill_status === "RECOVERY_REQUIRED",
  ).length;

  const recoveryOperations = drills.filter(
    (item) => item.recovery_performed === true,
  ).length;

  const corruptionDrills = drills.filter(
    (item) =>
      item.corruption_detected === true ||
      item.failure_type === "SIMULATED_CORRUPTION",
  ).length;

  const primaryFailures = drills.filter(
    (item) => item.failure_type === "SIMULATED_PRIMARY_FAILURE",
  ).length;

  const checksumMismatches = drills.filter((item) => {
    const primaryMismatch =
      item.primary_checksum &&
      item.expected_checksum &&
      item.primary_checksum !== item.expected_checksum;

    const secondaryMismatch =
      item.secondary_checksum &&
      item.expected_checksum &&
      item.secondary_checksum !== item.expected_checksum;

    return primaryMismatch || secondaryMismatch;
  }).length;

  return {
    total,
    successful,
    failed,
    attentionRequired,
    recoveryOperations,
    corruptionDrills,
    primaryFailures,
    checksumMismatches,

    successRate: total ? Number(((successful / total) * 100).toFixed(1)) : null,
  };
}

export function calculateMetricSummary(metrics) {
  const rtoValues = metrics.map(
    (item) => item.recovery_rto_seconds ?? item.recovery_workflow_seconds,
  );

  const rpoValues = metrics
    .map((item) => item.estimated_rpo_seconds)
    .filter((value) => value !== null && value !== undefined);

  const replicationCompleted = metrics.filter(
    (item) => item.replication_status === "COMPLETED",
  ).length;

  const replicationFailed = metrics.filter(
    (item) => item.replication_status === "FAILED",
  ).length;

  const replicationTimedOut = metrics.filter(
    (item) => item.replication_timed_out === true,
  ).length;

  return {
    averageRto: average(rtoValues),
    averageRpo: average(rpoValues),
    replicationCompleted,
    replicationFailed,
    replicationTimedOut,
  };
}

export function getLatestRecord(records) {
  if (!records.length) return null;

  return [...records].sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at),
  )[0];
}

export function formatSeconds(value) {
  if (
    value === null ||
    value === undefined ||
    !Number.isFinite(Number(value))
  ) {
    return "N/A";
  }

  return `${Number(value).toFixed(3)} sec`;
}

export function formatPercentage(value) {
  return value === null || value === undefined ? "N/A" : `${value}%`;
}

export function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return "N/A";

  const date = new Date(value);

  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? "N/A" : date.toLocaleString();
}

import { APP_CONFIG } from "../config/constants";

const API_BASE_URL = APP_CONFIG.API_BASE_URL;

function getFriendlyError(status) {
  switch (status) {
    case 401:
      return "Your session has expired. Please sign in again.";
    case 403:
      return "You don't have permission to access this document.";
    case 404:
      return "The document could not be found.";
    case 500:
      return "The server couldn't retrieve this document. Please try again.";
    default:
      return "Unable to retrieve the document. Please try again.";
  }
}

export async function fetchDocumentBlob(documentId) {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-token");

  if (!token) {
    throw new Error("Your session has expired. Please sign in again.");
  }

  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_BASE_URL}/v1/documents/${documentId}/download`,
    {
      method: "GET",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
    },
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    let message = getFriendlyError(response.status);

    try {
      const errorData = await response.json();

      // Don't expose raw server exceptions to the UI.
      if (response.status >= 500) {
        message =
          "The server couldn't retrieve this document. Please try again.";
      } else if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
        message = getFriendlyError(response.status);
      } else if (errorData.message) {
        message = errorData.message;
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep the friendly fallback message.
    }

    throw new Error(message);
  }

  return await response.blob();
}

export function downloadBlob(blob, filename) {
  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = objectUrl;
  link.download = filename || "document";
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
}

import { apiRequest, getApiErrorMessage } from "./api";

import { APP_CONFIG } from "../config/constants";

const DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT = "/v1/documents";
const API_BASE_URL = APP_CONFIG.API_BASE_URL;

function getAuthToken() {
  const token = localStorage.getItem("evidence-vault-token");

  if (!token) {
    throw new Error("Your session has expired. Please sign in again.");
  }

  return token;
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// GET DOCUMENTS
// --------------------------------------------------

export async function getDocuments({
  keyword = "",
  category = "",
  status = "",
  page = 0,
  size = APP_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
} = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();

  params.set("page", String(page));
  params.set("size", String(size));

  if (keyword.trim()) {
    params.set("keyword", keyword.trim());
  }

  if (category.trim()) {
    params.set("category", category.trim());
  }

  if (status.trim()) {
    params.set("status", status.trim());
  }

  return apiRequest(`${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}?${params.toString()}`);
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// UPLOAD DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export async function uploadDocument(file, category, description = "") {
  if (!(file instanceof File)) {
    throw new Error("Please select a valid document.");
  }

  if (!category?.trim()) {
    throw new Error("Please provide a document category.");
  }

  const formData = new FormData();

  // These names must match the Spring Boot upload endpoint.
  formData.append("file", file);
  formData.append("category", category.trim());

  if (description?.trim()) {
    formData.append("description", description.trim());
  }

  return apiRequest(`${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}/upload`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: formData,
  });
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// DELETE DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export async function deleteDocument(documentId) {
  if (!documentId) {
    throw new Error("A valid document ID is required.");
  }

  return apiRequest(`${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}/${encodeURIComponent(documentId)}`, {
    method: "DELETE",
  });
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// RESTORE DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export async function restoreDocument(documentId) {
  if (!documentId) {
    throw new Error("A valid document ID is required.");
  }

  return apiRequest(
    `${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}/${encodeURIComponent(documentId)}/restore`,
    {
      method: "POST",
    },
  );
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// COMMON PREVIEW / DOWNLOAD REQUEST
// --------------------------------------------------

async function fetchDocumentFile(documentId, action) {
  if (!documentId) {
    throw new Error("A valid document ID is required.");
  }

  if (!["preview", "download"].includes(action)) {
    throw new Error("Unsupported document operation.");
  }

  const token = getAuthToken();

  const endpoint =
    `${DOCUMENTS_ENDPOINT}/` + `${encodeURIComponent(documentId)}/${action}`;

  let response;

  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${endpoint}`, {
      method: "GET",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        Accept: "*/*",
      },
      cache: "no-store",
    });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(
      `Unable to connect to the server to ${action} this document.`,
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const fallback =
      action === "preview"
        ? "The server couldn't preview this document. Please try again later."
        : "The server couldn't download this document. Please try again later.";

    const message = await getApiErrorMessage(response, fallback, endpoint);

    throw new Error(message);
  }

  return response.blob();
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// PREVIEW DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export function previewDocument(documentId) {
  return fetchDocumentFile(documentId, "preview");
}

// --------------------------------------------------
// DOWNLOAD DOCUMENT
// --------------------------------------------------

export function downloadDocument(documentId) {
  return fetchDocumentFile(documentId, "download");
}

export function formatFileSize(bytes) {
  if (bytes === null || bytes === undefined) {
    return "N/A";
  }

  const size = Number(bytes);

  if (!Number.isFinite(size) || size < 0) {
    return "N/A";
  }

  if (size === 0) {
    return "0 Bytes";
  }

  const units = ["Bytes", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];

  const index = Math.min(
    Math.floor(Math.log(size) / Math.log(1024)),
    units.length - 1,
  );

  return `${(size / Math.pow(1024, index)).toFixed(2)} ${units[index]}`;
}

export function formatDocumentDate(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return "N/A";
  }

  const date = new Date(value);

  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? "N/A" : date.toLocaleString();
}

export function getFileExtension(filename = "") {
  if (!filename || !filename.includes(".")) {
    return "FILE";
  }

  return filename.split(".").pop().toUpperCase();
}

export function getNormalizedContentType(contentType = "") {
  return String(contentType).toLowerCase().split(";")[0].trim();
}

export function isTextDocument(contentType = "", filename = "") {
  const type = getNormalizedContentType(contentType);

  const extension = String(filename).toLowerCase().split(".").pop();

  const textExtensions = ["txt", "csv", "json", "xml", "log", "md"];

  return (
    type.startsWith("text/") ||
    ["application/json", "application/xml"].includes(type) ||
    textExtensions.includes(extension)
  );
}

export function isPreviewable(contentType = "", filename = "") {
  const type = getNormalizedContentType(contentType);

  const extension = String(filename).toLowerCase().split(".").pop();

  const supportedTypes = [
    "application/pdf",
    "image/png",
    "image/jpeg",
    "image/webp",
    "image/gif",
  ];

  const supportedExtensions = [
    "pdf",
    "png",
    "jpg",
    "jpeg",
    "webp",
    "gif",
    "txt",
    "csv",
    "json",
    "xml",
    "log",
    "md",
  ];

  return (
    supportedTypes.includes(type) ||
    type.startsWith("image/") ||
    isTextDocument(type, filename) ||
    supportedExtensions.includes(extension)
  );
}

export function getDocumentStatus(status) {
  return String(status || "UNKNOWN").toUpperCase();
}

============================================================
FILE: verifier\checksum.py
============================================================


import hashlib


def calculate_sha256(content: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def verify_checksum(content: bytes, expected_checksum: str) -> bool:
    actual_checksum = calculate_sha256(content)

    return actual_checksum.lower() == expected_checksum.lower()

FILE: verifier\corruption.py
============================================================


from database import get_document
from s3_client import (
    get_s3_location,
    get_latest_data_version,
    download_version
)
from checksum import calculate_sha256, verify_checksum


def simulate_primary_corruption(document_id: int):

    document = get_document(document_id)

    if not document:
        raise ValueError("Document not found")

    if document["status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise ValueError("Only ACTIVE documents can be tested")

    storage_key = document["storage_key"]
    expected_checksum = document["sha256_checksum"]

    # Obtain the actual primary object.
    primary_s3, primary_bucket = get_s3_location("primary")

    version = get_latest_data_version(
        primary_s3,
        primary_bucket,
        storage_key
    )

    if version is None:
        raise ValueError("No primary object version found")

    original_content = download_version(
        primary_s3,
        primary_bucket,
        storage_key,
        version["VersionId"]
    )

    # Simulate corruption in memory only.
    corrupted_content = bytearray(original_content)

    if corrupted_content:
        position = len(corrupted_content) // 2
        corrupted_content[position] ^= 0x01
    else:
        corrupted_content.extend(b"CORRUPTED")

    corrupted_content = bytes(corrupted_content)

    corrupted_checksum = calculate_sha256(
        corrupted_content
    )

    corruption_detected = not verify_checksum(
        corrupted_content,
        expected_checksum
    )

    return {
        "document_id": document_id,
        "storage_key": storage_key,
        "original_version_id": version["VersionId"],
        "expected_checksum": expected_checksum,
        "original_checksum": calculate_sha256(original_content),
        "corrupted_checksum": corrupted_checksum,
        "original_size": len(original_content),
        "corrupted_size": len(corrupted_content),
        "corruption_detected": corruption_detected,
        "actual_s3_object_modified": False
    }


============================================================
FILE: verifier\database.py

import mysql.connector
import json

from config import (
    MYSQL_HOST,
    MYSQL_PORT,
    MYSQL_DATABASE,
    MYSQL_USER,
    MYSQL_PASSWORD
)


def get_connection():
    return mysql.connector.connect(
        host=MYSQL_HOST,
        port=MYSQL_PORT,
        database=MYSQL_DATABASE,
        user=MYSQL_USER,
        password=MYSQL_PASSWORD
    )


def get_document(document_id: int):
    connection = get_connection()

    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor(dictionary=True)

        cursor.execute(
            """
            SELECT
                id,
                original_filename,
                storage_key,
                content_type,
                file_size_bytes,
                sha256_checksum,
                status
            FROM documents
            WHERE id = %s
            """,
            (document_id,)
        )

        return cursor.fetchone()

    finally:
        connection.close()

def get_document_version(document_id: int, version_id: str):
    """
    Retrieve one exact version belonging to a document.
    The version ID must match a row in document_versions.
    """
    connection = get_connection()

    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor(dictionary=True)

        cursor.execute(
            """
            SELECT
                id,
                document_id,
                s3_version_id,
                original_filename,
                content_type,
                file_size_bytes,
                sha256_checksum,
                created_at
            FROM document_versions
            WHERE document_id = %s
              AND s3_version_id = %s
            LIMIT 1
            """,
            (document_id, version_id)
        )

        return cursor.fetchone()

    finally:
        connection.close()


def get_latest_document_version(document_id: int):
    """
    Retrieve the most recently inserted version for a document.

    Auto-incrementing ID is used as the ordering source because
    created_at may contain timestamps written in different time zones.
    """
    connection = get_connection()

    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor(dictionary=True)

        cursor.execute(
            """
            SELECT
                id,
                document_id,
                s3_version_id,
                original_filename,
                content_type,
                file_size_bytes,
                sha256_checksum,
                created_at
            FROM document_versions
            WHERE document_id = %s
            ORDER BY id DESC
            LIMIT 1
            """,
            (document_id,)
        )

        return cursor.fetchone()

    finally:
        connection.close()


def save_recovery_version(
    document_id: int,
    version_id: str,
    filename: str,
    content_type: str,
    size: int,
    checksum: str
):
    """
    Atomically record a recovered S3 version and update document metadata.

    The document row is locked before inserting the version.
    Timestamps are written in UTC.
    """
    connection = get_connection()
    cursor = None

    try:
        connection.start_transaction()
        cursor = connection.cursor()

        # Confirm the document exists and lock it during this transaction.
        cursor.execute(
            """
            SELECT id
            FROM documents
            WHERE id = %s
            FOR UPDATE
            """,
            (document_id,)
        )

        document = cursor.fetchone()

        if document is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Document {document_id} does not exist."
            )

        # Record the exact S3 version that was recovered.
        cursor.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO document_versions (
                document_id,
                s3_version_id,
                original_filename,
                content_type,
                file_size_bytes,
                sha256_checksum,
                created_at
            )
            VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, UTC_TIMESTAMP())
            """,
            (
                document_id,
                version_id,
                filename,
                content_type,
                size,
                checksum
            )
        )

        # Update the current document metadata.
        cursor.execute(
            """
            UPDATE documents
            SET original_filename = %s,
                content_type = %s,
                file_size_bytes = %s,
                sha256_checksum = %s,
                status = 'ACTIVE',
                delete_marker_version_id = NULL
            WHERE id = %s
            """,
            (
                filename,
                content_type,
                size,
                checksum,
                document_id
            )
        )

        connection.commit()

    except Exception:
        connection.rollback()
        raise

    finally:
        if cursor is not None:
            cursor.close()

        connection.close()


def create_drill_table():
    connection = get_connection()

    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor()

        cursor.execute(
            """
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dr_drills (
                id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
                document_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
                primary_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
                secondary_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
                recovery_performed BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
                drill_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
                replication_lag_seconds DOUBLE NULL,
                rto_seconds DOUBLE NOT NULL,
                expected_checksum VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
                primary_checksum VARCHAR(64) NULL,
                secondary_checksum VARCHAR(64) NULL,
                corruption_detected BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
                failure_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE',
                recovery_source VARCHAR(30) NULL,
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            )
            """
        )

        # Safely migrate an existing table.
        cursor.execute(
            """
            SELECT COLUMN_NAME
            FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
            WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE()
              AND TABLE_NAME = 'dr_drills'
            """
        )

        existing_columns = {
            row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()
        }

        migrations = {
            "corruption_detected":
                "ALTER TABLE dr_drills ADD COLUMN corruption_detected BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE",

            "failure_type":
                "ALTER TABLE dr_drills ADD COLUMN failure_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NONE'",

            "recovery_source":
                "ALTER TABLE dr_drills ADD COLUMN recovery_source VARCHAR(30) NULL"
        }

        for column, sql in migrations.items():
            if column not in existing_columns:
                cursor.execute(sql)

        connection.commit()

    except Exception:
        connection.rollback()
        raise

    finally:
        connection.close()

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import mysql.connector
import snowflake.connector
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# -------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD PROJECT ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES
# -------------------------------------------------

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
load_dotenv(PROJECT_ROOT / ".env")


# -------------------------------------------------
# 2. MYSQL CONNECTION
# -------------------------------------------------

def get_mysql_connection():
    return mysql.connector.connect(
        host=os.getenv("MYSQL_HOST", "127.0.0.1"),
        port=int(os.getenv("MYSQL_PORT", "3307")),
        database=os.getenv("MYSQL_DATABASE", "evidence_vault"),
        user=os.getenv("MYSQL_USER", "root"),
        password=os.getenv("MYSQL_PASSWORD")
    )


# -------------------------------------------------
# 3. SNOWFLAKE CONNECTION
# -------------------------------------------------

def get_snowflake_connection():

    required = [
        "SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT",
        "SNOWFLAKE_USER",
        "SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD",
        "SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE",
        "SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE",
        "SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA"
    ]

    missing = [
        key for key in required
        if not os.getenv(key)
    ]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing Snowflake environment variables: "
            + ", ".join(missing)
        )

    return snowflake.connector.connect(
        account=os.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT"),
        user=os.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_USER"),
        password=os.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD"),
        warehouse=os.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE"),
        database=os.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE"),
        schema=os.getenv("SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA"),
        autocommit=False
    )


# -------------------------------------------------
# 4. EXTRACT DATA FROM MYSQL
# -------------------------------------------------

def extract_mysql_data():

    connection = get_mysql_connection()

    queries = {
        "DR_DRILLS": """
            SELECT
                id,
                document_id,
                primary_verified,
                secondary_verified,
                recovery_performed,
                drill_status,
                replication_lag_seconds,
                rto_seconds,
                expected_checksum,
                primary_checksum,
                secondary_checksum,
                corruption_detected,
                failure_type,
                recovery_source,
                created_at
            FROM dr_drills
            ORDER BY id
        """,

        "DR_RECOVERY_MANIFESTS": """
            SELECT
                id,
                manifest_id,
                document_id,
                failure_type,
                source_region,
                destination_region,
                source_version_id,
                recovered_version_id,
                expected_checksum,
                source_checksum,
                recovered_checksum,
                file_size_bytes,
                rto_seconds,
                verification_status,
                manifest_path,
                manifest_json,
                created_at
            FROM dr_recovery_manifests
            ORDER BY id
        """,

        "DR_METRICS": """
            SELECT
                id,
                document_id,
                failure_type,
                recovered_version_id,
                recovery_workflow_seconds,
                estimated_rpo_seconds,
                replication_status,
                replication_observation_seconds,
                created_at
            FROM dr_metrics
            ORDER BY id
        """
    }

    extracted = {}

    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor(dictionary=True)

        for table_name, query in queries.items():
            cursor.execute(query)
            extracted[table_name] = cursor.fetchall()

            print(
                f"Extracted {len(extracted[table_name])} "
                f"rows from MySQL table {table_name}"
            )

        return extracted

    finally:
        connection.close()


# -------------------------------------------------
# 5. PREPARE DATA FOR SNOWFLAKE
# -------------------------------------------------

def prepare_value(column, value):

    if column in (
        "primary_verified",
        "secondary_verified",
        "recovery_performed",
        "corruption_detected"
    ):
        return None if value is None else bool(value)

    if column == "manifest_json" and value is not None:

        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
            return json.dumps(value)

        if isinstance(value, bytes):
            return value.decode("utf-8")

        return str(value)

    return value


# -------------------------------------------------
# 6. LOAD DATA INTO SNOWFLAKE
# -------------------------------------------------

TABLE_COLUMNS = {
    "DR_DRILLS": [
        "id",
        "document_id",
        "primary_verified",
        "secondary_verified",
        "recovery_performed",
        "drill_status",
        "replication_lag_seconds",
        "rto_seconds",
        "expected_checksum",
        "primary_checksum",
        "secondary_checksum",
        "corruption_detected",
        "failure_type",
        "recovery_source",
        "created_at"
    ],

    "DR_RECOVERY_MANIFESTS": [
        "id",
        "manifest_id",
        "document_id",
        "failure_type",
        "source_region",
        "destination_region",
        "source_version_id",
        "recovered_version_id",
        "expected_checksum",
        "source_checksum",
        "recovered_checksum",
        "file_size_bytes",
        "rto_seconds",
        "verification_status",
        "manifest_path",
        "manifest_json",
        "created_at"
    ],

    "DR_METRICS": [
        "id",
        "document_id",
        "failure_type",
        "recovered_version_id",
        "recovery_workflow_seconds",
        "estimated_rpo_seconds",
        "replication_status",
        "replication_observation_seconds",
        "created_at"
    ]
}



def load_into_snowflake(extracted):

    connection = get_snowflake_connection()

    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor()

        cursor.execute("BEGIN")

        for table_name, columns in TABLE_COLUMNS.items():

            rows = extracted[table_name]

            cursor.execute(
                f"DELETE FROM {table_name}"
            )

            if not rows:
                print(f"No records available for {table_name}")
                continue

            column_sql = ", ".join(
                column.upper() for column in columns
            )

            value_sql = ", ".join(
                "PARSE_JSON(%s)"
                if column == "manifest_json"
                else "%s"
                for column in columns
            )

            insert_sql = f"""
                INSERT INTO {table_name} ({column_sql})
                SELECT {value_sql}
            """

            values = [
                tuple(
                    prepare_value(column, row.get(column))
                    for column in columns
                )
                for row in rows
            ]

            for row_values in values:
                cursor.execute(insert_sql, row_values)

            print(
                f"Loaded {len(values)} rows into "
                f"Snowflake table {table_name}"
            )

        connection.commit()

        print("\nSnowflake data load completed successfully.")

    except Exception:
        connection.rollback()
        print("Snowflake load failed. Transaction rolled back.")
        raise

    finally:
        connection.close()

# -------------------------------------------------
# 7. VERIFY SNOWFLAKE ROW COUNTS
# -------------------------------------------------

def verify_snowflake_data():

    connection = get_snowflake_connection()

    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor()

        print("\nSNOWFLAKE TABLE COUNTS")

        for table_name in TABLE_COLUMNS:

            cursor.execute(
                f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name}"
            )

            count = cursor.fetchone()[0]

            print(f"{table_name}: {count} rows")

    finally:
        connection.close()


# -------------------------------------------------
# 8. MAIN ETL EXECUTION
# -------------------------------------------------

def main():

    print("Starting Document Evidence Vault ETL...\n")

    extracted = extract_mysql_data()

    load_into_snowflake(extracted)

    verify_snowflake_data()

    print("\nETL PROCESS FINISHED.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import logging

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException

from database import (
    create_drill_table,
    save_drill_result,
    get_drill_history,
    create_manifest_table,
    get_recovery_manifests,
    create_metrics_table,
    save_dr_metrics,
    get_dr_metrics,
    get_document
)

from manifest import create_recovery_manifest
from verification import verify_document
from recovery import recover_document
from metrics import (
    calculate_rto,
    estimate_rpo_seconds,
    track_replication
)
from corruption import simulate_primary_corruption

import secrets

from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from config import PYTHON_SERVICE_TOKEN


logger = logging.getLogger("evidence-vault.dr")


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):

    if not PYTHON_SERVICE_TOKEN:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "PYTHON_SERVICE_TOKEN is missing. "
            "Configure it in the project root .env file."
        )

    create_drill_table()
    create_manifest_table()
    create_metrics_table()

    yield

app = FastAPI(
    title="Document Evidence Vault - DR Verification API",
    description=(
        "Independent document integrity verification "
        "and disaster recovery service"
    ),
    version="2.0.0",
    lifespan=lifespan
)

@app.middleware("http")
async def authenticate_internal_service(
    request: Request,
    call_next
):
    # Protect all internal API endpoints.
    if request.url.path.startswith("/api/v1/"):

        provided_token = request.headers.get(
            "X-Service-Token",
            ""
        )

        if not PYTHON_SERVICE_TOKEN:
            return JSONResponse(
                status_code=503,
                content={
                    "detail": "Service authentication is not configured"
                }
            )

        if not secrets.compare_digest(
            provided_token,
            PYTHON_SERVICE_TOKEN
        ):
            return JSONResponse(
                status_code=401,
                content={
                    "detail": "Unauthorized service request"
                }
            )

    return await call_next(request)


def _observe_recovery_replication(
    document_id: int,
    recovery_result: dict
):
    """
    Observe CRR status for the exact newly recovered primary version.
    """

    document = get_document(document_id)

    if not document:
        raise ValueError(
            "Document disappeared while recording recovery metrics"
        )

    upload_started_at = datetime.fromisoformat(
        recovery_result["upload_started_at"]
    )

    return track_replication(
        storage_key=document["storage_key"],
        version_id=recovery_result["new_primary_version_id"],
        upload_started_at=upload_started_at,
        timeout_seconds=60,
        interval_seconds=2
    )



def record_recovery_metrics(
    document_id: int,
    failure_type: str,
    recovery_result: dict,
    before: dict,
    drill_duration: float,
    replication: dict
):
    """
    Persist recovery RTO separately from total drill duration.
    """

    recovery_rto = recovery_result.get(
        "recovery_duration_seconds"
    )

    if recovery_rto is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "Recovery result does not contain a measured RTO"
        )

    estimated_rpo = estimate_rpo_seconds(
        before.get("primary"),
        before.get("secondary")
    )

    metrics = {
        "document_id": document_id,
        "failure_type": failure_type,
        "recovered_version_id": (
            recovery_result["new_primary_version_id"]
        ),
        "recovery_workflow_seconds": recovery_rto,
        "recovery_rto_seconds": recovery_rto,
        "drill_duration_seconds": drill_duration,
        "estimated_rpo_seconds": estimated_rpo,
        "replication_status": replication["replication_status"],
        "replication_observation_seconds": (
            replication.get("replication_observation_seconds")
        ),
        "replication_timed_out": replication.get(
            "timed_out", False
        ),
        "replication_error_code": replication.get("error_code")
    }

    save_dr_metrics(metrics)

    return metrics


def _create_drill_result(
    document_id: int,
    before: dict,
    after: dict,
    recovery_performed: bool,
    rto_seconds: float,
    failure_type: str = "NONE",
    corruption_detected: bool = False
):
    """
    Build a consistent DR drill record for database persistence.
    """

    primary_verified = after["primary"]["verified"]
    secondary_verified = after["secondary"]["verified"]

    if primary_verified and secondary_verified:
        status = "SUCCESS"
    elif secondary_verified:
        status = "RECOVERY_REQUIRED"
    else:
        status = "FAILED"

    return {
        "document_id": document_id,
        "primary_verified": primary_verified,
        "secondary_verified": secondary_verified,
        "recovery_performed": recovery_performed,
        "drill_status": status,
        "replication_lag_seconds": None,
        "rto_seconds": rto_seconds,
        "expected_checksum": after["expected_checksum"],
        "primary_checksum": after["primary"].get(
            "actual_checksum"
        ),
        "secondary_checksum": after["secondary"].get(
            "actual_checksum"
        ),
        "corruption_detected": corruption_detected,
        "failure_type": failure_type,
        "recovery_source": (
            "Singapore" if recovery_performed else None
        )
    }


def _create_manifest_for_recovery(
    document_id: int,
    failure_type: str,
    before: dict,
    after: dict,
    recovery_result: dict,
    rto_seconds: float,
    drill_status: str
):
    """
    Create a manifest using the actual verified recovery result.
    """

    return create_recovery_manifest(
        document_id=document_id,
        failure_type=failure_type,
        source_region="ap-southeast-1",
        destination_region="ap-south-1",
        source_version_id=(
            recovery_result["selected_source_version_id"]
        ),
        recovered_version_id=(
            recovery_result["new_primary_version_id"]
        ),
        expected_checksum=after["expected_checksum"],
        source_checksum=(
            recovery_result["source_checksum"]
        ),
        recovered_checksum=(
            recovery_result["recovered_checksum"]
        ),
        file_size=after["primary"]["size_bytes"],
        rto_seconds=rto_seconds,
        verification_status=drill_status,
        recovery_result=recovery_result
    )


def _run_recovery_observation(
    document_id: int,
    failure_type: str,
    before: dict,
    recovery_result: dict,
    started_at: datetime
):
    """
    Wait for the replication observation, verify the final state,
    and persist the drill, manifest and metrics.
    """

    replication = _observe_recovery_replication(
        document_id,
        recovery_result
    )

    # Verify after the replication observation.
    after = verify_document(document_id)

    completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    # RTO ends when recovery and the MySQL update have completed.
    rto_seconds = recovery_result["recovery_duration_seconds"]

    # Drill duration also includes replication observation and final checks.
    drill_duration = calculate_rto(
        started_at,
        completed_at
    )

    drill_result = _create_drill_result(
        document_id=document_id,
        before=before,
        after=after,
        recovery_performed=True,
        rto_seconds=rto_seconds,
        failure_type=failure_type,
        corruption_detected=(
            failure_type == "SIMULATED_CORRUPTION"
        )
    )

    save_drill_result(drill_result)

    manifest_result = _create_manifest_for_recovery(
        document_id=document_id,
        failure_type=failure_type,
        before=before,
        after=after,
        recovery_result=recovery_result,
        rto_seconds=rto_seconds,
        drill_status=drill_result["drill_status"]
    )

    metrics_result = record_recovery_metrics(
        document_id=document_id,
        failure_type=failure_type,
        recovery_result=recovery_result,
        before=before,
        drill_duration=drill_duration,   
        replication=replication
    )

    return {
        "recovery": recovery_result,
        "verification": after,
        "drill": drill_result,
        "manifest": manifest_result,
        "metrics": metrics_result,
        "drill_duration_seconds": drill_duration
    }

@app.post("/api/v1/drills/run/{document_id}")
def run_drill(document_id: int):
    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    try:
        before = verify_document(document_id)

        primary_verified = before["primary"]["verified"]
        secondary_verified = before["secondary"]["verified"]

        recovery_result = None
        replication = None
        recovery_performed = False

        if not primary_verified and secondary_verified:
            recovery_result = recover_document(document_id)
            recovery_performed = True

            replication = _observe_recovery_replication(
                document_id,
                recovery_result
            )

            after = verify_document(document_id)

        else:
            after = before

        completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

        drill_duration = calculate_rto(
            started_at,
            completed_at
        )

        rto_seconds = (
            recovery_result["recovery_duration_seconds"]
            if recovery_performed
            else drill_duration
        )

        drill_result = _create_drill_result(
            document_id=document_id,
            before=before,
            after=after,
            recovery_performed=recovery_performed,
            rto_seconds=rto_seconds
        )

        save_drill_result(drill_result)

        manifest_result = None
        metrics_result = None

        if recovery_performed:
            manifest_result = _create_manifest_for_recovery(
                document_id=document_id,
                failure_type="SIMULATED_PRIMARY_FAILURE",
                before=before,
                after=after,
                recovery_result=recovery_result,
                rto_seconds=rto_seconds,
                drill_status=drill_result["drill_status"]
            )

            metrics_result = record_recovery_metrics(
                document_id=document_id,
                failure_type="SIMULATED_PRIMARY_FAILURE",
                recovery_result=recovery_result,
                before=before,
                drill_duration=drill_duration,
                replication=replication
            )

        return {
            "simulation": "AUTOMATED_DR_CHECK",
            "before_recovery": before,
            "recovery": recovery_result,
            "after_recovery": after,
            "drill": drill_result,
            "manifest": manifest_result,
            "drill_duration_seconds": drill_duration,
            "metrics": metrics_result
        }

    except ValueError as error:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=str(error)
        )

    except Exception as error:
        logger.exception(
            "Automated DR drill failed for document %s",
            document_id
        )
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Automated disaster recovery drill failed"
        ) from error

@app.post(
    "/api/v1/drills/simulate-primary-failure/{document_id}"
)
def simulate_primary_failure(document_id: int):
    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    try:
        # Capture the current state without modifying either bucket.
        before = verify_document(document_id)

        if not before["secondary"]["verified"]:
            raise ValueError(
                "Simulation stopped: Singapore replica failed "
                "integrity verification. Recovery is unsafe."
            )

        # This is a controlled primary-failure assumption.
        # It does not delete or disable the Mumbai S3 object.
        recovery_result = recover_document(document_id)

        result = _run_recovery_observation(
            document_id=document_id,
            failure_type="SIMULATED_PRIMARY_FAILURE",
            before=before,
            recovery_result=recovery_result,
            started_at=started_at
        )

        return {
            "simulation": "PRIMARY_UNAVAILABLE_ASSUMED",
            "before_recovery": before,
            **result
        }

    except ValueError as error:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=str(error)
        )

    except Exception as error:
        logger.exception(
            "Primary failure drill failed for document %s",
            document_id
        )
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Primary failure recovery drill failed"
        ) from error


@app.post(
    "/api/v1/drills/simulate-corruption/{document_id}"
)
def simulate_corruption_drill(document_id: int):
    started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    try:
        # Capture the exact database-selected version in both regions.
        before = verify_document(document_id)

        # Corruption is simulated in memory only.
        corruption = simulate_primary_corruption(document_id)

        if not corruption["corruption_detected"]:
            raise ValueError(
                "Corruption simulation failed to detect "
                "a checksum mismatch"
            )

        # The secondary copy must be clean before recovery.
        if not before["secondary"]["verified"]:
            raise ValueError(
                "Singapore replica failed verification. "
                "Recovery stopped to protect evidence integrity."
            )

        recovery_result = recover_document(document_id)

        result = _run_recovery_observation(
            document_id=document_id,
            failure_type="SIMULATED_CORRUPTION",
            before=before,
            recovery_result=recovery_result,
            started_at=started_at
        )

        return {
            "simulation": "CORRUPTION_DETECTED",
            "corruption_details": corruption,
            "secondary_verification": before["secondary"],
            **result
        }

    except ValueError as error:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=str(error)
        )

    except Exception as error:
        logger.exception(
            "Corruption recovery drill failed for document %s",
            document_id
        )
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Corruption recovery drill failed"
        ) from error

import json
import uuid

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from database import save_recovery_manifest


MANIFEST_DIRECTORY = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "manifests"
)


def create_recovery_manifest(
    document_id: int,
    failure_type: str,
    source_region: str,
    destination_region: str,
    source_version_id: str,
    recovered_version_id: str,
    expected_checksum: str,
    source_checksum: str,
    recovered_checksum: str,
    file_size: int,
    rto_seconds: float,
    verification_status: str,
    recovery_result: dict = None
):
    """
    Create a portable JSON recovery manifest and persist its
    database record.

    The JSON file is retained if the MySQL insert fails so that
    the evidence can be reconciled instead of silently discarded.
    """

    if not document_id:
        raise ValueError("Document ID is required")

    if not source_version_id or not recovered_version_id:
        raise ValueError("Both source and recovered version IDs are required")

    if file_size < 0:
        raise ValueError("File size cannot be negative")

    recovery_result = recovery_result or {}

    MANIFEST_DIRECTORY.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True
    )

    manifest_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    created_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    manifest = {
        "manifest_id": manifest_id,
        "document_id": document_id,
        "failure_type": failure_type,
        "source_region": source_region,
        "destination_region": destination_region,
        "source_version_id": source_version_id,
        "recovered_version_id": recovered_version_id,
        "expected_checksum": expected_checksum,
        "source_checksum": source_checksum,
        "recovered_checksum": recovered_checksum,
        "file_size_bytes": file_size,
        "rto_seconds": round(float(rto_seconds), 3),
        "verification_status": verification_status,
        "source_verified": recovery_result.get(
            "source_verified"
        ),
        "destination_verified": recovery_result.get(
            "destination_verified"
        ),
        "database_updated": recovery_result.get(
            "database_updated"
        ),
        "recovery_duration_seconds": recovery_result.get(
            "recovery_duration_seconds"
        ),
        "recovery_started_at": recovery_result.get(
            "recovery_started_at"
        ),
        "recovery_completed_at": recovery_result.get(
            "recovery_completed_at"
        ),
        "created_at": created_at
    }

    manifest_path = (
        MANIFEST_DIRECTORY
        / f"recovery-{manifest_id}.json"
    )

    temporary_path = manifest_path.with_suffix(".json.tmp")

    manifest_json = json.dumps(
        manifest,
        indent=4,
        ensure_ascii=False
    )

    # Write to a temporary file first, then atomically rename it.
    temporary_path.write_text(
        manifest_json,
        encoding="utf-8"
    )

    temporary_path.replace(manifest_path)

    # Persist the manifest metadata in MySQL.
    try:
        save_recovery_manifest(
            manifest,
            str(manifest_path)
        )

    except Exception as error:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Recovery JSON manifest was created, but its MySQL "
            "record could not be saved. "
            f"Manifest file retained at: {manifest_path}"
        ) from error

    return {
        "manifest_id": manifest_id,
        "manifest_path": str(manifest_path),
        "manifest": manifest,
        "database_saved": True
    }
